name: Benny Bash
summary: Survive this horror/puzzle adventure. Uncover the secrets of a cursed video game from the '80s while a malevolent entity hunts you. Solve escape room-style puzzles, navigate eerie labyrinths, and see how your actions in the game shape the real world. Stay sharp... and stay alive.

name: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth
summary: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth drops you into the war-torn year of 2361, where Mechanized Corps fight for control of the Sol system's resources. Choose from four customizable classes, arm yourself with devastating weapons, and fight in intense squad-based combat. Battle offline or online with friends!

name: The Pub Life Simulator
summary: Open your own pub with The Pub Life Simulator, serve food and drinks to keep your customers happy. Enjoy this exciting simulation experience solo or with friends. Unlock higher-quality products, expand your pub, and build the best business in town!

name: Replicube
summary: Replicube is an open-ended programming puzzle game/toy about writing code to replicate 3D voxel-based objects. Solve puzzles, pursue leaderboard glory, or just make art to share with the in-game community.

name: The Second Sight: Dead Reckoning
summary:
You’re an urban legend in a county full of them. When you were thirteen, you were found passed out in the road by one of the local cops. No missing persons report. No fingerprints on file. No memories. Just a name.

Oh, and some bizarre psychic powers.

You're content with simplicity. You like your isolated cabin and helping Carter track down missing persons. You know that in theory there are more people like you out there, but you've never wanted to look behind the curtain to find out.

However, with the disappearance of a local teen named Casey Powell and a recent attempt on your foster father's life, your serene, isolated life comes abruptly to its end and a new chapter begins.

name: Expelled!
summary: A School Prefect has been pushed out of a window, and everyone's blaming YOU. Can you find the culprit - or someone to take the fall - before you get EXPELLED? Mystery with a wicked twist, from the creators of Overboard! and A Highland Song.

name: Disaster Arms: Impact Project B.A.H.N.
summary: Disaster Arms is a 2D run-and-gun boss rush game. Shoot and punch your way through a ceaseless gauntlet of giant alien and robotic lifeforms.

name: Flesh Made Fear
summary: Tank controls. Fixed cameras. Pure Terror. Set in a haunting world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, this game brings back the survival horror mechanics you know and love while pushing the genre into terrifying new depths.

name: Digimon Story: Time Stranger
summary: The latest in the Digimon Story series is finally here! In this RPG, unravel a mystery that spans across the human world and the Digital World, collecting and raising a wide variety of Digimon to save the world.

name: Train Valley Origins
summary: The cutest management game about trains. Choo-choo! Manage increasingly complex railroad. The rich history of railway transport awaits! From steam engines to futuristic marvels. Explore different eras and countries and witness the evolution of train technology.

name: Dave the Diver: Ichiban's Holiday
summary: Dave the Diver: Ichiban's Holiday is a DLC that adds content themed around the Like a Dragon franchise.

name: Lies of P: Overture
summary: Lies of P: Overture is a story expansion for Lies of P that introduces new narrative developments, environments, enemies, and weapons. It builds on the core game's mechanics while expanding the dark reimagining of the Pinocchio tale with additional challenges and lore.

name: Dreams of Another
summary: Dreams of Another is a third-person exploration-action game built around the philosophical theme, “No Creation Without Destruction.” Rather than destroying objects by shooting—as in traditional shooting games—here, your shots materialize and create the world. This unconventional mechanic offers a gameplay experience that challenges the norms of the genre and invites players into a whole new dimension.

name: Days Gone Remastered
summary:
Ride into a desperate, dog-eat-dog world in the definitive Days Gone experience, remastered for the PlayStation5 console.

Fight to survive an environment ravaged by a deadly pandemic as former outlaw biker, Deacon St. John. Risk the threats of the Broken Road on the back of your trusty Drifter bike as you face terrifying hordes of relentless feral Freakers – as well as dangerous gangs of humans.

name: Stellar Blade x Goddess of Victory: Nikke
summary: Worlds collide in an epic cross-over of heroic proportions in this add-on expansion for Stellar Blade featuring mini games, a new Boss showdown and unlockable cosmetics from mobile app GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE.

name: Armored Core
summary: A port of Armored Core, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

name: Armored Core: Project Phantasma
summary: A port of Armored Core: Project Phantasma, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

name: Armored Core: Master of Arena
summary: A port of Armored Core: Master of Arena, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

name: Patapon 3
summary: Patapon 3 is a rhythm game for the PlayStation Portable now back on modern consoles.

name: Metal Eden
summary:
An adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS.
A HYPER UNIT ASKA is sent on a suicide mission to rescue citizens' COREs from MOEBIUS, an orbital city turned into a deadly trap. Dive into cybernetic warfare, face the ENGINEERS, and uncover the secrets of METAL EDEN.

name: Days Gone: Broken Road
summary: Days Gone – Broken Road DLC is an expansion to Days Gone, an open-world action-adventure game set in a harsh wilderness two years after a devastating global pandemic. Days Gone – Broken Road DLC features all new content and features that will enhance your Days Gone experience as you fight for tomorrow in this brutal relentless world.

name: Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk
summary: Build a vending machine empire in this cozy idle sim! Manage staff, decorate locations, and watch your business thrive. Play actively or let it run passively in the background with relaxing music to enjoy while you work or unwind.

name: Seeker of the Ruins
summary: As a fearless dwarf delver, navigate interesting underground labyrinths & ruins, uncover hidden treasures, solve riddles and hide from monsters. Use various items and potions to survive and outsmart environmental hazards in this immersive non-combat adventure. Delve into the unknown and reclaim lost treasures!

name: Hell is Us: Deluxe Edition
summary:
The Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us includes:
- The Hollow Walker Pack, featuring an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI
- The Military Pack, featuring an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI
- An exclusive investigation
- The Art Pack, including the digital artbook and original soundtrack

name: Neon Hearts City
summary: A private investigator, tracking a missing person, uncovers a conspiracy between humans and androids and a secret that could change everything. Neon Hearts City is a retro point-and-click adventure that thrusts you into a grungy cyberpunk city of the future.

name: A la Card
summary: Buckle up for a roguelike deckbuilder boiling over with card mutation mischief and limitless synergies. It's a food-truck-themed deckbuilding roguelike all about bending the rules and letting the player get weird with absurd synergies.

name: Mobile Suit Gundam Seed: Battle Destiny Remastered
summary: Become a pilot in the world of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, for the first time available with English localization! Engage in thrilling, action-packed Gundam battles, complete missions, and tune up your newly acquired Mobile Suits!

name: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater - Digital Deluxe Edition
summary:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes both the game and the Sneaking DLC Pack at a reduced price.
Includes:
・METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
・Sneaking DLC Pack
Uniform: Battle Dress (PW ver.)​
Uniform: Sneaking Suit (PW ver.)​
Uniform: Crocodile Suit​
Uniform: Naked (Woodland)​
Uniform: Naked (Ammunition Belt)
Uniform: Gold
Face: Glasses
Face: Sunglasses
Equipment: Kerotan Mask
Equipment: GA-KO Mask

name: Fubuki: Zero in on Holoearth
summary: 『FUBUKI ~zero in on Holoearth~』is a high-speed pixel action game where you control the protagonist, Shirakami Fubuki, and battle using swords and skills.

name: Dungeon Warfare III
summary: Forge invincible defenses with lethal traps and devious machines, and crush relentless waves of adventurers in the ultimate tower defense showdown!

name: Inkborn
summary: A roguelike, deckbuilder game with a twist, tactical combat, and huge replayability. Collect cards, traverse the dark lands, battle elusive enemies, and grow your town - as you push deeper into the chasm of madness.

name: Dead Trash
summary: Years into a brutal lockdown, a once-thriving city lies in ruins, abandoned by its government and overrun by vicious, mindless infected. Grab your hammer, collect your nerves and enter the mayhem.

name: Driveloop: Survivors
summary: Driveloop is a fast-paced driving roguelike shooter. Drift, blast and ram your way through waves of steampunk enemies. Upgrade your vehicle with powerful weapons, recruit unique crew members and survive intense battles as you build the ultimate combat machine. Can you survive the chaos?

name: Totally Defenceless
summary: Totally Defenceless is a wave-based tower defence game. You will need to protect your energy cores from the invading alien bugs by strategically constructing a maze of towers to alter their path to your advantage.

name: Kabuto Park
summary: Enjoy summer in Kabuto Park! Capture the cutest bugs, train them and win the Summer Beetle Battles Championship in this little bug collection game! Upgrade your equipment to find rarer, stronger and shinier beetles, butterflies, bees or dragonflies.

name: Phantom Playhouse
summary: Phantom Playhouse is a suspenseful survival game inspired by the Five Nights at Freddy's series. Immerse yourself in a dark story as you uncover the secrets of a mysterious circus known as Funtime Park. As the nights progress, you'll face terrifying animatronics lurking in the shadows. Will you survive and uncover the truth behind this chilling experience?

name: Uncursed
summary: Uncursed is a first-person psychological horror game blending immersive storytelling, environmental exploration, and puzzle-solving. Navigate a house filled with unsettling secrets, uncover the dark past hidden beneath its walls, and escape before history repeats itself.

name: Better Mart Simulator
summary: Create and expand your dream supermarket. Manage your aisles, inventory, machines, cleaning, deliveries, and staff. Welcome your customers and decorate every corner. Play solo or with up to 6 players and transform a small shop into a retail empire!

name: Darkest Days
summary: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play

name: DeadWire
summary: Hack, link, and shoot in a fast-paced top-down cyberpunk shooter. Create devastating chain reactions to outwit enemies, break records and save your childhood mentor from a ruthless syndicate

name: Broventure: The Wild Co-op
summary: Broventure = Vampire Survival + Base building + Co-op. Band together with friends and obliterate hordes of grueling enemies, gather crucial resources, and transform your camp into a sanctuary of liberation.

name: Monster Train 2
summary: It's time to raise Hell in Heaven! Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

name: Replicat
summary: A roguelike memory deckbuilder where you bend the rules of card matching with wild combos, strategy-defining curios and cards featuring some personality-packed cats.

name: The Fat Cat Fest
summary: Fat Cat Fest is a party game full of minigames and challenges, where funny cats will compete to see who is the fastest and most skillful eater.

name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Sogeumgang
summary: A simulation game where you directly operate a drone based on actual drone flight footage!

name: Laundering Simulator
summary: Laundering Simulator puts you in charge of a two-faced enterprise – a laundromat as a front and a counterfeiting workshop hidden in its back. As the shady launderer, Eddie Wiser, you run this unconventional enterprise and deal with small-business management, counterfeiting, a criminal underground, nosy authorities, and a rage-inducing grandmother!

name: Noobs Are Coming
summary: You are the final boss in this brutal synergy arena roguelike. Select a character, equip boss patterns and combine tons of attacks to create unique builds. Play solo or in co-op!

name: Night of the Stars
summary: Every 888 years in Faust, it's the Night of the Stars! You've been chosen by your community to reach out for the 3 Half-Gods and stop the ever-expanding Void from swallowing every life form. Your salvation lies in the joint power of the Half-Gods. But will they even want to collaborate with you?

name: Bomb Around
summary:
... and find out!
Physics based rage game inspired by jump king and other foddian games. Play as unique characters trying to reach as high as possible. Use interesting upgrades to reach new heights and discover the difficulty ahead. Compete on the leaderboards with speedrun, daily seed, or just casual play.

name: Pinball FX VR
summary:
Bring pinball to life with the ultimate ‘80s arcade atmosphere - now fully immersive in virtual reality. Dive into a fully customizable and interactive setting with the integrated Mixed Reality mode and transform your living room into a personal arcade paradise with cabinets and unlockable decorations.

This includes the same tables as Pinball FX's "Secrets and Shadows" bundle: Curse of the Mummy, Pinball Noir, and Sky Pirates. Many more are available as DLC.

name: Her Love, Like Poison
summary: A dark lesbian horror/romance story so toxic it's emitting spores. Ethel, a shy university student, ventures into the wintry woods late one night, where she meets an enchanting raven-haired femme fatale - but all is not as it seems.

name: Retronika
summary: Hop on your hoverbike and go guns blazing. Fight through chaotic traffic and vibrant cityscapes, face off against towering metallic bosses, and drones, and prove who’s truly in charge in Retronika.

name: Shotgun Cop Man
summary: GO TO HELL, ARREST SATAN. Propel yourself to justice and glory on a journey through hell in this punchy, crunchy, son-of-a-gun precision platformer from the creator of My Friend Pedro.

name: A Bibelot: Y-Break
summary: No joke this time, I'll describe the game for what it is: - 10 levels, 3 difficulties, playable in 2 players Coop! - A Versus mode, against your enemy or friend, or against ???

name: Dreadzone
summary: Dreadzone is a survival game set in a deadly quarantine zone. Scavenge for resources, craft tools, build shelter, and survive against dangerous animals, zombies, mutants, and other survivors. Explore the zone where desperation drives everyone to do whatever it takes to survive.

name: R.E.P.O.
summary: R.E.P.O. (Retrieve, Extract and Profit Operation) is an online cooperative survival horror game for up to six players, developed by Swedish studio Semiwork using the Unity engine. Players are tasked with locating valuable physics-based objects within procedurally generated environments and carefully transporting them to extraction points without damaging them, all while avoiding hostile creatures. Between levels, players spend earned currency on permanent upgrades, weapons, and tools at a service station. The game emphasizes verbal coordination and strategic planning among teammates.

name: Among Us 3D
summary: Teamwork and betrayal in space… now in 3D! In this party game, Crewmates work together to complete tasks before one or more Impostors kill everyone aboard. Experience all of the same deception and deceit as the original Among Us in all three dimensions.

name: Rocket Squad: Infinity
summary:
Rocket Squad is a team-based first-person shooter.
Infiltrate perilous planets, gather resources, and return safely to your shelter.
Utilize each character's unique abilities and strategically form your team to restore order to the universe.

name: Recharge
summary: Recharge is an RC car racing game built with Unreal Engine and ray tracing, offering realistic graphics. Designed for both RC enthusiasts and casual players, it combines thrilling races, deep customization, and diverse game modes—blending precision with excitement for a dynamic racing.

name: Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics
summary: Line Clipper: Tennis Tactics is a turn-based strategic tennis game. Zero in on your opponent’s pattern of play to gain the upper hand. Line up the perfect shot and simulate the outcome before committing to your next play. Sometimes the court is wide open, and sometimes you have to aim for the lines.

name: Leftovers KO!
summary: Leftovers KO! is a Punch-Out-inspired, hand-drawn animated boxing game where you fight a bunch of leftovers. After a long day at work, you come home to find that your uneaten food has come to life—and it's here to beat you up... with its hands! Defeat them all and uncover the truth!

name: Beyond the Map
summary: Survival ARPG set in a procedurally generated fantasy world. Build a base, gear up, and fight to survive as you chase better loot and stronger enemies.

name: The Electrifying Incident: A Monster Mini-Expedition
summary: An adorable bite-sized adventure from the creators of A Monster’s Expedition - explore the facility, avoid the live electricity, and repair the malfunctioning reactor.

name: Blackshard
summary: Blackshard is a first-person exploration game. Wander through a strange megastructure, the Labyrinth, to unravel its mysteries... Your behavior within the Labyrinth will define the outcome of your journey. What path will you choose to take?

name: Zombie Graveyard Simulator
summary: Manage your Graveyard by day as you bury and cremate bodies, maintain graves, fulfill visitor requests, grow crops, run a shop and unlock upgrades. When night falls, face relentless zombie hordes as you build defenses to protect your work and fight to survive in Zombie Graveyard Simulator!

name: The Lonesome Guild
summary: In a world consumed by loneliness, only friendship can save the day. Lead a quirky cast in this colorful single-player ARPG full of heart, battles, and bonds that change everything.

name: Ways of Alchemy
summary: Become a medieval alchemist in this card game. Grow, craft, and brew your way to power. Hire adventurers, discover ancient recipes, and master the art of alchemy. No wands are required — just wit and wisdom.

name: Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids
summary: An action-strategy game where you gather Brainium, build a base, and command your army of bots to defeat the freaky Brains-in-Jars aliens. Lead from the front with your hero, Chip or Clawz, or both in co-op. Look out for ejected alien brains, you can squish ‘em!

name: Warborne: Above Ashes
summary: Fierce flames of war are now raging. We roam, fight, and defeat all who stand in the way of our ambitions. Join a faction in the sci-fi post apocalyptic-style multiplayer PvP war game Warborne Above Ashes, and fight for honor!

name: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3
summary: MATCH DNA BUBBLES IN AN UNDERGROUND LAB TO KEEP YOUR PSYCHIC CLONE FROM INVADING YOUR MIND AND TURNING YOU INTO A CANNIBAL. This is the match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania you didn't know you needed.

name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 – Deluxe Edition
summary:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a ground-breaking turn-based RPG with unique real-time mechanics, making battles more immersive and addictive than ever. Explore a fantasy world inspired by Belle Époque France in which you battle devastating enemies.

Get the ultimate Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 experience with the Deluxe Edition!
The Deluxe Edition includes:

·Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Base Game
·The “Flowers” Collection - Six outfits and hairstyles inspired by the Flowers of Lumière, along with six additional “Gommage” outfit variations. One for each playable character.
·“Clair” - A custom outfit for Maelle
·“Obscur” - A custom outfit for Gustave

name: Firefly Village
summary: The Firefly Village awaits! A bite-sized, streamlined farming sim that focuses on moments that matter, without wasting a single second of your time. Build a homestead, raise crops, tend to livestock, make friends, and enjoy a pocket of paradise where farming is a delight and friends plentiful.

name: Blade & Soul Neo
summary:
Blade & Soul NEO is a modern reinterpretation of Blade & Soul's iconic Wuxia-themed, fantasy world, offering unparalleled action-based combat and character customization. Players can reconnect with the original spirit of the free-to-play, open-world MMORPG in a richer, visually enhanced experience set in a world of Asian mythology where fast-paced combat collides with the stunning visual beauty.

Gamers will re-live the original storyline as a hero determined to restore honor to their clan that’s been wiped out by enemy forces. Players can pick one of four playable races based on animal lore, including the Dragon, Qilin, Phoenix and Turtle, and amongst seven classes, including Assassin, Blade Dancer, Blade Master, Destroyer, Force Master, Kung Fu Master, and Summoner.

name: Last Report
summary: Last Report is a dark horror game where you play as a night shift park ranger. While monitoring the camera footage, you start noticing strange events. Uncover the terrifying secret of the National Park. Something moved in the window, but don’t worry it’s probably just another deer, right?

name: Dice Legends
summary: Dice Legends is a roguelike deckbuilder with dice-driven combat. Roll, flip, and split dice to manipulate your deck, stack powerful effects, and unleash devastating card combos. Make your own luck!

name: Wrap House Simulator
summary: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

name: Detective: Rainy Night
summary: Detective Rainy Night is a psychological horror narrative adventure with elements of deduction. Violent crimes, mature stories, and a touch of horror await you at the Motel Holiday. Grab a pencil and paper because solving this case won’t be easy.

name: The Two Thinkers
summary: A challenging puzzle and platformer game for 2 players. Play with a friend, combine your skills, think logically, and overcome obstacles together to reach the exit and complete each level. Only by working as a team will you be able to overcome every challenge and progress!

name: QuantumPulse 2A
summary: Solve programming puzzles on a fictional computer with radio-based communication and unique limitations. Competitively optimize to compete on leaderboards against friends and the global community.

name: Food Wagon
summary: "Awaken the Forbidden Flavors of the Gods!" Join Lanya, the adorable and charming chef-hero, on a forbidden culinary adventure in another world! Hunt, gather, and cook to grow stronger and challenge the authority of the gods. Cooking is freedom! A roguelike action RPG to satisfy everyone's tastes!

name: The Derailed
summary: The Derailed - a first-person psychological horror game.

name: Ender Theater
summary: Cards! Tactics! Roguelike! Multiple Endings! Build your deck, strategize on the board, and boldly move forward with the surprises dice bring! The joys and sorrows, births and destructions of this city are all up to you to decide!

name: Magic Survivor Undead
summary: Slay the infected, Fight the gods and protect humanity. Only you can rebuild what was lost in this roguelike game. Gather resources to build up your base, craft weapons and create magics in this game influenced by Vampire Survivors and Call of Duty Zombies.

name: Shapefighter
summary: An arcade-style, twin-stick shooter where you blast through 30 unique waves of shapes.

name: Color Factory
summary: Color Factory is a relaxing factory-building game where strategy meets automation. Start with basic colors, refine them into vivid shades, and craft canvases of all sizes. Optimize your machines, scale operations at your own pace, and master automation to build a masterpiece of efficiency.

name: Cozy Organizer
summary: Organize, decorate, align, and stack items in cozy environments.

name: The Last Caretaker
summary: The Last Caretaker is a thoughtful take on the survival-crafting genre, where every decision you make and every action has a consequence. Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted world where the fate of humanity rests in your hands. Your mission is clear: recover human seeds, reactivate the Lazarus Complex, and launch the last of humanity to the stars.

name: Buffet Knight: Decadent Full Course
summary: Gobble up everything around you in this hungry action adventure as Buffet Knight. Battle monsters, conquer puzzling dungeons, save the culinary world! The more you eat, the stronger you grow... But will you end up biting off more than you can chew?

name: Myrmidon
summary: Invite a friend online and embark on a puzzle-platformer adventure exploring the bond between an animator and his puppet. Work together to clear obstacles across the sprawling sets of a stop-motion animation workshop and find out to what lengths the power of imagination can take you.

name: Blades of Fire
summary: Introducing Blades of Fire, an all-new action adventure that takes you across a beautiful world full of uncertainty and challenge. You take on the role of Aran de Lira, firstborn of the King’s Ward. The newly crowned Queen Nerea has cast a powerful spell that turns steel into stone and only her arms of abominations wield the divine metal against which other blades shatter…

name: La Quimera
summary: La Quimera is a story-driven FPS set in dystopian future Latin America. In a fractured world where microstates rely on mercenary forces, you are an operative caught in a web of lies and deception. Play alone or with up to two friends geared with futuristic weapons, exoskeletons and combat abilities.

name: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Daima: Adventure Through The Demon Realm Part 1
summary: Part 1 of an additional story set in the world of the Dragon Ball DAIMA anime series: DAIMA: Adventure Through The Demon Realm.

name: Tracktopia
summary: Tracktopia is a strategy game with city-building elements, where your city moves on tracks and serves as a super powerful unit. Expand it to boost production, advance technologies, and create smaller units to ultimately defeat the enemy nation!

name: Through the Edges
summary:
Step into a world divided by the enigmatic Spheres, where different races live under strict balance – a balance that has never been questioned… until now.

As the protagonist, an ordinary young person from a remote village, you receive an unexpected invitation to a grand ball. What seems like a stroke of fate soon turns into a revelation of hidden anomalies, ancient powers, and a secret that could shatter reality itself.

But you are not alone.

Meet intriguing characters from various races, each carrying their own secrets, struggles, and desires. Will they become your allies, rivals, or something more? Your choices will shape their destinies – and your own.

name: Gorn 2
summary: GORN 2 is a ludicrous sequel to the hit VR gladiator simulator from Free Lives. It's bigger, wilder, and stronger than ever before, with mighty new weapons to wield, treacherous new traps to avoid, and new power-ups to imbue you with supernatural strength. Enjoy GORN 2's improved VR combat as you battle the five sons of the God of the Afterlife across an array of heavenly realms, with in-your-face combat so irresponsibly violent you'll check your headset for blood spatters when you're done.

name: Breaking Bricks
summary: Get ready to experience the thrill of BREAKING BRICKS, an addictive arcade game that will captivate players of all ages. With 40 challenging levels, you’ll have a blast breaking bricks and progressing to new stages. The goal of BREAKING BRICKS is simple: use your skill and quick reflexes to destroy all the blocks on the screen. But it won’t be as easy as it sounds! As you advance through the levels, the blocks become tougher, requiring smart strategies to overcome each challenge. What truly sets BREAKING BRICKS apart are the exciting power-ups you’ll discover throughout the game. These power-ups range from extra balls to multiply your score, to powerful weapons that destroy multiple blocks at once. Each power-up adds an extra layer of excitement and strategy, keeping you on your toes and eager for more. With its fast-paced action and intuitive controls, BREAKING BRICKS delivers an engaging experience from start to finish. Every level provides a sense of achievement as you progress.

name: Earth vs. Mars
summary: Faced with a terrifying Martian invasion, you must lead Earth’s forces in a battle for our planet’s future. Create powerful human-creature super soldiers to fight an alien menace in this turn-based strategy game.

name: Eyes of Hellfire
summary: Eyes of Hellfire is a co-op gothic horror game. Hoist the candelabra and, along with your friends, step into the darkened halls of the Hellfire Club.

name: Overcome Your Fears: Caretaker
summary: Overcome Your Fears - is a psychological atmospheric horror game that immerses you in a world of the unknown.

name: Augmented Empire
summary: Step into New Savannah, 2058. The acclaimed VR title Augmented Empire now debuts on PC. Command a ragtag team of misfits through 26 missions of turn-based, tactical battles. Overthrow a corrupt elite in a cyberpunk world brimming with strategy and rich storytelling.

name: Borzoi
summary: BORZOI is a first-person survival horror game where you are relentlessly hunted by a giant, demonic Borzoi dog. Experience high tension as you fight for survival, solve high-stakes puzzles, and uncover the dark legacy of a twisted cult—all while evading a predator that cannot be tamed

name: Kaizen: A Factory Story
summary: Kaizen is an open-ended puzzle automation game from the original Zachtronics team, set in 1980s Japan. Design, build, and optimize production lines to create iconic products, like calculators, camcorders, and arcade machines.

name: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine
summary: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine is a short adventure puzzle game. Use your wits, creativity and puzzle solving ability to help Flibbius take to the skies!

name: Find 100 Ducks and Blast Them!
summary: In this game, you must blast 100 toy ducks! Relax, take aim, and let the feathers fly! With light-hearted gameplay and cute ducks to hunt, it's a casual first-person experience full of wholesome, family-friendly fun!

name: Unleashed Recompiled
summary: Unleashed Recompiled is an unofficial PC port of the Xbox 360 version of Sonic Unleashed created through the process of static recompilation. The port offers Windows and Linux support with numerous built-in enhancements such as high resolutions, ultrawide support, high frame rates, improved performance and modding.

name: Wednesdays
summary: "The hardest part is not to speak up. It’s being heard." Part video game, part graphic novel, Wednesdays seeks to raise awareness about child sexual abuse through a surprisingly uplifting story.

name: Gothic 1 Remake: Nyras Prologue
summary: Welcome to the Colony – an exclusive stand-alone prologue to the Gothic 1 Remake. Take your first step into the world of this genre-defining classic RPG by experiencing an entirely new story: the first day of a fresh inmate in the prison colony.

name: Islanders: New Shores
summary: Welcome to ISLANDERS: New Shores. Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.

name: Memes At War
summary: Memes At War is a high quality first-person shooter that brings meme characters to life on the battlefield. Through multiple maps and game-modes you will be able to gain ranks on the leaderboards.

name: Flat 9
summary: A psychological horror set in a deserted apartment, where you're trapped in a relentless cycle. Armed with a strange device, you must find and report every anomaly to escape.

name: Absolum
summary: Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4
summary: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 is a remake of the two skateboarding games originally released in the early 2000s. Players perform tricks, complete objectives, and explore varied skate parks across global locations. The gameplay emphasizes fluid controls, combo chaining, and arcade-style challenges. Each title features a roster of professional skaters, along with customizable characters and gear. The collection preserves the core mechanics of the originals while offering updated visuals and performance on modern platforms.

name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3
summary: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 is a remake of the original Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3, bundled in the Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 collection.

name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4
summary: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4 is a remake of the original Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4, bundled in the Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 collection.

name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
summary: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.

name: World Reborn
summary: After a cataclysmic event fractures the world into many fragile realities, you've been recruited to be part of a community of heroes to save one of the realities—and our own—from a nefarious force called the Rot.

name: Kokoro Kitchen
summary: In this delightful farm-to-table cooking game, you’ll restore a cozy Japanese restaurant, cultivate a bountiful garden of fresh ingredients, and prepare mouth-watering Japanese dishes for hungry locals. Use your culinary skills to help bring a little life back to the spirit world!

name: Bongo Cat
summary: Bongo cat needs your help. Bongo cat needz more hatz!!! Every time you press a key, Bongo cat will punch your taskbar. Type, click, play, work to collect more points. Which hats will you find?

name: Filiy Eclipse
summary: Filiy Eclipse is an exploration action RPG that explores a mysterious science fiction world.Explore the surface, underground and sky of the star to discover what happened aboard it.

name: Sub-Verge
summary: Conversation is a dangerous game. Manipulate a fractured band of renegade divers to reach the depths of this short narrative puzzle. Uncover alliances and expose betrayals — before something horrific from the dark abyss silences you all. Don’t let the conversation get too deep.

name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
summary:
Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.

Current PC players can transfer both GTAV Story Mode progress and GTA Online characters and progression with a one-time migration from the legacy version of GTAV to GTAV Enhanced.

name: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
summary: RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business is a new standalone adventure of RoboCop: Rogue City. OmniTower is their fortress, violence their language. Face elite mercenaries all the way to the top of the tower and enforce the law amidst the chaos!

name: Sheepherds!
summary: Sheepherds! is a cozy co-op party game where you and your sheepdog buddies guide colorful flocks through beautiful landscapes to sheer their wool. Take your time and have fun barking, running and discovering magical places together— or take on challenges to win even more treats!

name: Tetris: The Grand Master 4 - Absolute Eye
summary:
The action puzzle game Tetris the Grand Master first appeared in game arcades in August 1998, and became a beloved game for gamers as a Tetris game packed with addictive elements.

Then, Tetris the Absolute: The Grand Master 2 was released in 2000, and Tetris the Grand Master 3: Terror Instinct was released in 2005. The latest in the series, Tetris the Grand Master 4: Absolute Eye, ​​will be available on Steam for the first time in 20 years.

This time, Tetris the Grand Master 4: Absolute Eye offers players a deeper, more strategic Tetris experience, and the depth of the game will satisfy even experienced players. New modes have been added, and this game will test your skills to the limit, requiring precise strategy and fast play.

Of course, there are also modes that even beginners to Tetris can enjoy, and the game is so full of charm that you will find yourself retrying it over and over again.

The sound is handled by Shinji Hosoe, who is well known for the Tetris the Grand Master series. His music, full of tension and excitement, will increase the player’s concentration and make the game even more exciting.

name: Rentlord
summary: A roguelike real estate game where you buy properties, manage your income, and overcome unique weekly challenges.

name: Don't Forget to Smile
summary:
Welcome to Don't Forget to Smile – the game that throws you into an adrenaline-fueled, anxiety-ridden trip through the darkest corners of modern life.

10+ weapons, 15+ augments, synergies and upgrades will help you break out of your day to day and fight back.

name: Taco Attack!
summary: Catch ingredients to make tacos. But look out—catch the wrong ingredient and your taco will break! Use items to trip up your opponents or give yourself a boost. What are you waiting for?! Onion mark...get set...TACOOOOO!!

name: Ghost Town
summary: Ghost Town is a single player VR puzzle-adventure from the makers of The Room. London, 1983. Edith Penrose is a ghost hunter, busy exorcising her way through the city's restless spirits. But after her brother goes missing Edith must draw upon her wits & supernatural talents to unravel the mystery.

name: Titan Isles
summary: Titan Isles is a co-op action adventure game for VR platforms. Join up to 3 friends to battle giant Titans with unique weapon and traversal combos.

name: Out of Sight VR
summary: Out of Sight VR pulls you into a chilling nightmare where you see through the eyes of a child’s only comfort—her teddy bear. Guide Sophie through a sinister mansion and evade the lurking horrors that stalk her every move. The shadows are watching. And Sophie is depending on you.

name: Surviving Mars: Pioneer
summary: The Red Planet is vast, desolate, and utterly indifferent to your survival. Surviving Mars: Pioneer is the first made-for-VR entry in the Surviving Mars universe, challenging you to carve out an existence in one of the most hostile environments imaginable.

name: Katamari Damacy Rolling Live
summary: Katamari Damacy Rolling LIVE — the Katamari franchise’s first original game in nearly eight years — launches exclusively on Apple Arcade. In this new adventure, players roll the Katamari as ordered by the King of All Cosmos, embracing the series’ iconic gameplay of “roll, stick, and grow.”

name: 5 Nights at Bobr Kurwa
summary: Beaver Lyolik ate too many mushrooms and became a KURWA! Only the chosen ones can survive these 5 nights!

name: Many Nights a Whisper
summary: A short interactive essay on dreams, pressure, and expectations. Take part in an ancient ritual where one shot determines the fate of a generation.

name: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite
summary: Face unpredictable dangers, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter and play with up to 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members.

name: The Light of Celestia
summary: The Light of Celestia is a story-driven action-adventure featuring intense combat and mystical exploration. Step into the role of Zoe, a destined protector bound to ancient magic, as she unravels the secrets of Eldoria. Confront dark forces, uncover lost truths, and embrace the light within.

name: Speed Surge
summary: Strap in and ignite your engines in Speed Surge, the adrenaline-pumping arcade racing game where every second counts! Dash through thrilling tracks as you race against time. Are you ready to become the ultimate speedster?

name: Mythic Realms
summary: Bring the adventure to your living room in Mythic Realms’ mixed-reality fantasy adventure. Test your skills and gather loot to build up your very own VR kingdom. Mythical creatures and epic boss fights await in this RPG roguelite.

name: Wall World 2
summary: The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall!

name: Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus - Tanuki Kabuki
Bee Simulator: The Hive
summary: Live the epic adventure of a tiny bee in a vast world! Collect pollen, race through jet streams, and protect your hive from wasps. Now even bigger with The Hive expansion - gather resources, build and customize your very own beehive!

name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced
summary:
This release contains the 3 classic side-scrolling 2D action games "Azure Striker Gunvolt" (2014), "Azure Striker Gunvolt 2" (2016), and "Azure Striker Gunvolt 3" (2022), including all available DLC.

Enjoy not just the action, but deep story that plays out without interrupting gameplay in "Live Novel" dialog that plays during missions. With full voiceover (Japanese only in Gunvolt 1 and 2) and a total of 37 vocal tracks sung by the "Muses", you'll be immersed in the near-future dystopian world.

In addition, the series director has renewed all three titles, polishing the action gameplay and updating the music. Previously separately available items such as voice drama CDs are now included in-game in Library Mode, making for the most complete "final version" of the trilogy.

name: Spartan Survivors
summary: Fight hordes of Covenant & Flood in this new game mixing Roguelike, Halo & Bullet Heaven for hundreds hours of mindless fun!

name: Disco Elysium
summary: Disco Elysium for Android is a mobile adaptation of ZA/UM’s narrative role-playing game. It keeps the murder investigation and dialogue-led structure, but presents the game through touch controls, vertical-screen play, new 360-degree scenes, revised investigation mechanics, and new audio/voice work. The Android version was also released with a free opening section and a single purchase to unlock the full experience, making its format closer to an episodic mobile adaptation than the original open-ended RPG presentation.

name: PowerWash Simulator 2
summary: PowerWash Simulator is back, bubbling with fresh locations, soap-erior equipment and splashy features. Effortlessly transform soiled surroundings into clean, serene scenes, solo or with pals. Satisfaction is a spray away!

name: Path of Fury: Episode I - Tetsuo's Tower
summary: Trek to Yomi creator brings you Path of Fury! Thrusted into a relentless gauntlet, armed with nothing but your fists and raw willpower. Tetsuo’s fortress rises above you, each floor crawling with enemies that are ready to end you. Your only option? Punch your way through every last one of them.

name: Lunacid: Tears of the Moon
summary: Lunacid: Tears of the Moon is a First Person Dungeon Crawler made with the Sword of Moonlight - King’s Field making tool from 2000. Explore various dungeons for powerful weapons and spells to forestall the previsioned end of the world.

name: Ship, Inc.
summary: Run a wholesome shipping business! Ship, Inc. is a cozy wholesome job simulator where you are a packaging employee in a cargo shipment company. Follow the shipment orders, choose package size, and prepare parcels. Upgrade your office, deliver orders safely and quickly!

name: My Little Puppy
summary: "There is a saying that when you depart from this world, the dog who went ahead will warmly welcome you." While spending time in dog heaven, Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi suddenly catches his dad's scent. Now, he embarks on a journey to meet his dad. Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

name: Signal.
summary:
Signal. is an officially approved fan-made game based on the legendary serial experiments lain PlayStation 1 game. Developed by Team MJM, this occultic RPG reimagines the eerie, cybernetic world of Lain through a new perspective.

Players take on the role of Lain Iwakura, exploring the Wired, uncovering past logs, and interacting with familiar characters from both the anime and the original game. Unlike its PlayStation predecessor, which leaned towards an interactive adventure format, Signal. introduces RPG elements, relationship-building mechanics, and a deeper focus on unraveling mysteries hidden within the Wired.

name: Missile Command: Delta
summary: Missiles are incoming. The stakes are high. Only you can stop the destruction. Manage your pool of defenses strategically to survive rounds of incoming missiles in this high-pressure, tactical turn-based game. Will you be able to unravel the mystery in time?

name: I, Robot
summary: Jeff Minter is back with another unique take on a 1980s Atari arcade game: I, Robot. Reimagined in Minter’s signature assault of colors, shapes and sounds, this new take on the eclectic arcade title is built from the ground up with new challenges, new twists, and a whole lot of llamas.

name: The Séance of Blake Manor
summary: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

name: Look Mum No Computer
summary: Music meets mayhem in this twin-stick shooter action-RPG! Craft synthesizer modules to gain new weapons and experiment with the original music of Look Mum No Computer. Meet quirky NPCs, complete quests and battle huge bosses.

name: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
summary: Team up with a friend to reach a lost submarine and prevent the outbreak of war. Work together on two devices to solve increasingly challenging puzzles, where each of you has your own unique role to play.

name: Fresh Tracks
summary: Jump, dodge, and fight to the rhythm of the gods in this thrilling music-action game on skis. Take on obstacles and menacing enemies as you ski further into the darkness that has befallen the snow-covered land of Norwyn.

name: Lost Rift
summary: Lost Rift is a First Person Survival Shooter Adventure that blends base-building PVE co-op with high-stakes PvPvE extraction gameplay set on a mysterious archipelago that can be explored solo or in teams of up to 5 players.

name: Revenge of the Savage Planet: Cosmic Hoarder Edition
summary: Revenge of the Savage Planet is an upbeat, satirical action adventure Sci-Fi. Jump, shoot and collect your way across vibrant alien worlds, uncovering new gear and upgrades, while discovering various hidden secrets.

name: Elsewhere Electric
summary: A puzzle game powered by two: Navigate a mysterious facility to charge devices, solve puzzles, and reconfigure the map as you see fit. Uncover the secrets of the facility that await you both at its confounding core. Bring your friend, because you will not survive alone.

name: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord - War Sails
summary: Sail the high seas, lead mighty fleets, and forge your legacy in War Sails. Bringing naval warfare to Bannerlord for the first time, War Sails lets players command powerful ships, engage in thrilling sea battles, and master maritime conquest.

name: Frosthaven
summary: From the creative mind of Isaac Childres, the highly acclaimed board game moves to the digital realm in the video game adaptation of FROSTHAVEN! The dark fantasy tactical RPG features deep mechanics and challenging yet satisfying gameplay both in Single Player and Co-Op Online Multiplayer.

name: LAN Party Adventures
summary: Okay, Pedro is AWOL, and you have to get this LAN Party set up at the Game Store for the session later. Connect cables, install software, and solve puzzles all while you and the gang uncover the mystery of your missing friend.

name: Trident's Tale
summary: Uncover the secrets of the Storm Trident and rule the seas - Your legend awaits in Trident's Tale!

name: Minecraft: Spring to Life
summary: The Spring to Life drop is an update to Minecraft: Java Edition which brings more reasons to explore! Befriend new mob variants, marvel at glittering firefly bushes, seek out ambient sounds, and delight in an Overworld full of life.

name: Minecraft: Spring to Life
summary: The Spring to Life drop is an update to Minecraft: Bedrock Edition which brings more reasons to explore! Befriend new mob variants, marvel at glittering firefly bushes, seek out ambient sounds, and delight in an Overworld full of life.

name: Minecraft: Chase the Skies
summary: The Chase the Skies drop is an update to Minecraft: Java Edition which brings a new flying mount, opening up the skies for exploring, crafting, and (hopefully) surviving! Discover the skies with the new happy ghast, plan a group trip with the Player Locator bar guide and ride mobs and craft your leads and saddles.

name: Minecraft: Chase the Skies
summary: The Chase the Skies drop is an update to Minecraft: Bedrock Edition which brings a new flying mount, opening up the skies for exploring, crafting, and (hopefully) surviving! Discover the skies with the new happy ghast, plan a group trip with the Player Locator bar guide and ride mobs, craft your leads and saddles and prepare for the breathtaking views with Vibrant Visuals.

name: Futamata Renai: Two Times the Trouble
summary: Koga Nao never knew his life would take a wild turn when a night out at a college drinking party would result in a messy relationship with Toiro Kirame. Now forced to date her, his life only gets more complicated when his longtime crush, Nobuta Yua, decides to confess to him!

name: Hegzis
summary: Master the hex grid as you puzzle through colourfully chill stages, clearing lines and strategically using tools to assist!

name: Monster Energy Supercross 25: The Official Video Game
summary: Get ready for a new beginning with the upcoming 2025 season, official riders and tracks, a renewed gameplay thanks to Unreal Engine 5, and much more!

name: Brush Burial: Gutter World
summary: A murky first-person immersive sim with tightly-wound melee combat and tangled, vertical levels to explore. Use your forked tail to tie your enemies in knots and climb impossible heights. Kill your mark with quickness and cunning, using whatever tools you see fit.

name: A Bibelot: Tiret sur Will
summary: This is your average precision platformer. Playable in 4 player Coop, a choice to have a speedrun timer for well, speedrunners, tons (maybe an exaggeration) of secrets and places to go out of bounds, tons of achievements, tons of CRT scanlines, and maybe, tons of fun?

name: Stellaris: Shadows of the Shroud
summary:
Shadows of the Shroud is an expansion for Stellaris, released as a part of the Season 09 Expansion Pass in 2025.

The psionic plane holds untold power—but at what cost? Shadows of the Shroud is a complete overhaul of the Psionic Ascension path, introducing new moral dilemmas, patron allegiances, and the ever-present temptation of ultimate destruction.

name: Tour de France 2025
summary: The official game takes on a new dimension with new graphics for increased immersion. Take on the roads of the Tour de France 2025, sprint, climb, and try to win the mythical Yellow Jersey.

name: Wildgate
summary: Wildgate is a PVP multiplayer shooter that blends tactical ship-to-ship combat with fast-paced first-person action. Evade deadly environmental hazards, search for powerful weapons and ship upgrades, and be the first crew to escape with the Artifact... or the last crew left flying.

name: GeoGuessr: Steam Edition
summary: Explore the world with GeoGuessr Steam Edition! Compete against others, climb divisions, and prove your geography skills. Travel to stunning locations, analyze clues, and make your best guess.

name: Firefighter Frankie
summary: Help Firefighter Frankie, the brave Golden Retriever, save the town! Drive your firetruck, upgrade your tools, and fight fires . Find clues to solve the mystery and uncover who is causing the trouble. Relax and explore at your own pace in a colorful low-poly world.

name: F1 25
summary: Leave your mark on the world of racing in F1 25, the official video game of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship, featuring a revamped My Team mode, the thrilling third chapter of Braking Point, and more!

name: No Sleep for Kaname Date: From AI - The Somnium Files
summary:
Kaname Date and the AI-Ball, Aiba tackle a mysterious case and rescue Iris, an internet idol who has been forced to take part in a dangerous escape game.
Examine crime scenes and listen to testimonies in "Investigation". Enter the dream worlds of suspects and key witnesses in "Somnium". Solve puzzles to break out of locked rooms in the new "Escape" sections.
By moving between these three sections, obtain the necessary clues to solve the case.

name: Raidou Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army
summary: The story of apprentice detective and Devil Summoner extraordinaire Raidou Kuzunoha XIV returns in this remastered classic! Call upon your demons to solve supernatural mysteries and dispose of enemies.

name: Patapon 1+2 Replay
summary: Remastered bundle of the original critically-acclaimed Patapon and Patapon 2 which were released in 2007 and 2008.

name: Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar
summary: Searching for a peaceful farm life, a fresh mountain breeze, and your own market stall? Look no further than the friendly community of Zephyr Town! Here you’ll grow crops and raise animals, get to know the locals, and sell your wares at the town's bazaar to restore it to its former glory.

name: Gradius Origins
summary: This collection features 18 versions across all 7 arcade titles in the series, including the first-ever appearance of Gradius III AM Show Version on home consoles.

name: Salamander III
summary: Salamander III is the newest addition to the Gradius series, a legendary pioneer in the side-scrolling shooter genre, and comes with the original arcade versions of the previous games.

name: Tamagotchi Plaza
summary: Become a shopkeeper in Tamahiko Town. Engage with more than 100 Tamagotchi as they open, customize and grow more than a dozen different shops and improve your reputation with them in town.

name: Everybody’s Golf: Hot Shots
summary: Everybody’s favorite golf game series finally returns to the fairway! Hit the green with a variety of unique characters and courses in online and offline AND single and multiplayer modes!

name: Marvel Cosmic Invasion
summary: Marvel Cosmic Invasion is a side-scrolling beat 'em up featuring 15 playable Marvel heroes. Designed in the style of classic 1990s arcade brawlers, the game allows players to switch between two characters mid-battle using the Cosmic Swap mechanic. Each hero brings unique abilities and team-up attacks, with additional upgrades and rewards becoming available as players progress.

name: Super Robot Wars Y
summary: Super Robot Wars is a grid-based tactical combat RPG that brings units and pilots from a variety of anime together to battle their mutual foes. Rise, Unite, and Triumph!

name: Super Technos World: River City & Arcade Classics
summary: This exciting collection brings you 12 games in one, from developer Technos Japan known for creating the legendary River City and Double Dragon series. From arcade classics to region-exclusive titles, you’ll have plenty to explore in this collection! Get your hands on these rare games of legend!

name: Glowkeeper
summary: A luminescent puzzle game about manipulating elements. By the light of fireflies, link and dissolve elemental forces to construct bridges, break through obstacles, and traverse a glowing, interconnected world.

name: Mr. Elevator
summary: We are developing a puzzle solving game with an elevator motif. This game is currently in the early stages of development, but we plan to upload images and demos of the work in progress. Please follow us and add us to your wishlist!

name: Saihate Station: Twilight Railway
summary:
Two people vowed to escape from everything and spend eternity in paradise.

Many long years later, the train suddenly starts moving.....

name: Luxury Supermarket Simulator
summary: Step into the world of high-end retail with Luxury Supermarket Simulator! Manage your very own luxurious supermarket. Customize your store with furniture.

name: Huntsman
summary: Trapped inside a spider-infested research facility, Huntsman immerses you in a survival horror experience fueled by arachnophobia. Combining realistic spider behavior with intense tension, Huntsman will test your nerve like never before.

name: Renai Bakudan
summary:
Having just dealt with the roughest time in her life, Juri Kido's luck is finally turning around. At the invitation of her best friend, Juri moves to the small, coastal town of Akiyama; leaving behind the big city of Tokyo for good. But what Juri doesn’t know is just what kind of place this cozy locale really is...

Because Akiyama is not only home to a massive red-light district, but also houses the biggest, hottest, and weirdest love hotel in the world; HOTEL BAKUDAN!

After meeting seven beautiful ladies and scoring a job at the hotel, Juri knows that this is the golden opportunity she's been searching for. With so much sex, drama and romance at every turn, Juri has no doubt that living in Akiyama is going to change her life. Just what awaits her on these sunny shores?

Welcome to HOTEL BAKUDAN. We hope you enjoy your stay!

name: The Black Ice
summary: In a remote and mysterious research facility in Antarctica, an intense atmosphere of fear and death hangs in the air. In horror "The Black Ice", players find themselves exploring this haunting place alone, solving puzzles and fighting to stay alive as they face the chilling unknown.

name: Aracore Astromining Ventures
summary:
Hailing from one of the many slum communes of Mars, a young pilot is given a chance as a mining pilot for an upcoming corporation. The chaos of unregulated mining in the outer asteroid belt has our pilot flying dangerous missions to collect precious metals, salvage debris, and explore space in order to earn enough to help their community back home. With fellow pilots, CEOs, rival corporations, and freedom fighters, everyone has their own agenda, but what path will our pilot choose?

Explore over 20 mission locations, discovering their riches and secrets. You'll find, mine, break down, and haul precious resources from asteroids into your cargo, earning commission, but will you use your pay to help your community, yourself, or something more? As you converse with your bosses, colleagues, and rival factions, you'll discover more about the world, but be wary: actions have consequences: what you do, or fail to do, in a mission will dictate future missions and the direction of the story

name: Second Chances
summary: A turn-based RPG where every battle is a puzzle, and every choice carries weight. Guide Paul Kimbel, a troubled author trapped between life and death, through a haunting world built from his own imagination. No grinding—just pure strategy, exploration, and high-stakes combat.

name: The Last Meadow
summary: April Fool's game published by Discord in 2025

name: Dreams of Aether
summary: A collection of dozens of Aether-flavored microgames! Dive into the Dreams of Aether, where everyone is trapped in a never-ending nightmare! Meet some of the strangest characters Aether has to offer!

name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2
summary:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2 is an action fighting game based on the Demon Slayer series.

It follows the events of the anime, continuing the story of Tanjiro Kamado and his companions. Players take part in arena-based battles using characters with distinct moves and abilities. The game includes a story mode and versus modes for local and online play. It expands on the mechanics and roster introduced in the original Hinokami Chronicles.

name: Pac's Revenge
summary: Pac's Revenge is a retro-style FPS game. Strap on your boots, grab the nearest gun, and blast your way through countless demonic creatures before they can corrupt your whole world.

name: Dungeon Mori
summary: Dungeon Mori is a game inspired by the classic Dungeon Crawlers and Old School RPGs. With a simple, yet addicting gameplay, it features a turn based battle system combined with a choice based dungeon exploration.

name: Bouncy Bread
summary: Bouncy Bread is a simple and fun game with 40 challenging and balanced levels, offering a relaxing and accessible experience for players of all ages, with easy-to-learn mechanics and smooth progression.

name: Mario Kart World
summary: Mario Kart World is a kart racing game for the Nintendo Switch 2, featuring characters from the Mario franchise. It introduces an open-world design to the series, allowing players to drive freely between courses rather than selecting them from a menu. Races support up to 24 players and include new mechanics such as off-roading, boat racing, rail grinding, and wall riding. The game features a Knockout Tour elimination mode where racers compete across connected courses with periodic eliminations at checkpoints, as well as a Free Roam mode for open exploration and collectible-finding.

name: Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour
summary: Enter a virtual exhibition and gain insights into what makes Nintendo Switch 2 such a unique gaming experience. Through tech demos, minigames and other interactions, players will get to know the new system inside and out in ways they may never have known about otherwise.

name: Super Mario Party Jamboree: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV
summary: Super Mario Party Jamboree is getting even more minigames and an upgrade on Nintendo Switch 2! The upgrade expands on the base game and adds Nintendo Switch 2 gameplay features, such as mouse controls, enhanced rumble, sound recognition, and modes that use a camera accessory (sold separately).

name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
summary:
Travel across vast fields, through forests, and to mountain peaks as you discover what has become of the kingdom of Hyrule-and step into a world of discovery, exploration, and adventure that's been upgraded with performance enhancements in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition! With improved framerates, faster load times, and enhanced resolution and textures, this thrilling open-air adventure has never looked better!

The wilds of Hyrule make for a puzzling game of survival. Climb cliffs to scope out a destination; then cross great distances with the Paraglider or the horses you've tamed. You'll discover items for crafting, beasts to hunt, and plants to forage. Scavenge weapons and armor...or claim them from enemies! From hammers to helmets, items have specific stats, resistances, effects, and levels of durability. Use everything at your disposal to find and conquer more than 100 shrines. Luckily, the in-game Sheikah Slate can project Runes that manipulate objects and enemies in clever ways.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
summary:
In this sequel to The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, you’ll decide your own path through the sprawling landscapes of Hyrule and the mysterious islands floating in the vast skies above. Can you harness the power of Link’s new abilities to fight back against the malevolent forces that threaten the kingdom?

Now with 240 additional voice memories in the Zelda Notes mobile app, you can experience the game with additional lore!

name: Kirby and the Forgotten Land: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
summary: In Star-Crossed World, a new story included in the upgrade pack, Kirby must use his abilities, including the all-new Mouthful Modes, to clear a trail through uncharted territory. The upgrade pack will include this new content which can be played in single-player and local co-op, as well as improved performance for the entire game.

name: Drag x Drive
summary: Drag x Drive (pronounced “Drag and Drive”) challenges players to use the mouse controls with both Joy-Con 2 at the same time to intuitively steer, speed up, perform tricks and make plays such as dunks.

name: Street Fighter 6: Years 1-2 - Fighters Edition
summary: The Switch 2 version comes with exclusive game modes.

name: Hitman World of Assassination: Signature Edition
summary:
This greatest hits collection of the HITMAN series was previously available on Nintendo Switch systems via cloud streaming, but the Nintendo Switch 2 version will run natively on the console, allowing players to experience Agent 47’s globe-trotting adventures seamlessly offline and on the go.

HITMAN World of Assassination - Signature Edition includes the main campaign, Contracts mode, Escalation, Elusive Target arcades, featured live content, Freelancer game mode, plus all HITMAN 2 Expansion Pack & HITMAN 3 Deluxe Pack content.

name: Bravely Default: Flying Fairy - HD Remaster
summary:
Bravely Default, the first title in the Bravely series, remastered in high definition for a single screen. Discover the origins of the classic Brave and Default battle system alongside new and enhanced features. The story of light and shadow that never fades is reborn!

This version includes two new minigames: Luxencheer Rhythm Catch and Ringabel’s Panic Cruise.

name: Yakuza 0: Director's Cut
summary:
Yakuza 0: Director's Cut is the definitive edition of the critically acclaimed prequel to the Yakuza series.

Director's Cut content gives deeper insight into key incidents and character backstories with never-before-seen cutscenes and enhanced features like English and Chinese voiceovers, and multi-language text support. Plus, the Red Light Raid online multiplayer mode lets you join forces with friends and choose from 60 playable characters to take down hordes of enemies.

name: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
summary:
Fight the war for ancient Hyrule! Step on to the battlefield as Princess Zelda, King Rauru, and other legendary heroes as you fight to reclaim your homeland— and live the story of Demon King Ganondorf's invasion that was only briefly alluded to in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom game.

Princess Zelda is not alone in this war! Join Mineru, the Sages, and even some brand-new heroes in battles against Ganondorf's forces. Combine powerful Zonai Devices with your heroes' signature abilities to take down powerful bosses and their legions of minions.

name: Survival Kids
summary:
Welcome to Survival Kids, a survival adventure game available exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2!

Picture this: A dusty old attic, cobwebs, forgotten boxes and the faint smell of neglect. Four curious kids stumble upon an ancient, tattered map, sparking an unexpected adventure…

Setting out to sea upon their ramshackle boat, a sudden, ferocious storm hurls them into a hidden world brimming with danger and mystery. Now it’s down to you to help them work together and find their way home in Survival Kids - a fast-paced, co-op survival game for absolutely everyone!

Stranded on a series of unique islands, set upon the back of giant Whurtles, work together with up to 4 players in local or online co-op to explore, chop, craft, fish, cook and solve your way to safety - all whilst surviving everything the islands throw at you!

Master the island's challenges, use the Harmony Stones to tame the storm and make it back home with an epic story to tell!

name: Wild Hearts S
summary:
The maximum number of players for both online and local play has been increased from 3 to 4 players.

The update of additional beasts and modes in “WILD HEARTS” is included from the start.

This does not include additional weapons, Karakuri, or beasts. HDR is not supported.

Balance Adjustments.

name: Puyo Puyo Tetris 2S
summary: The Ultimate Puzzle Match, now Enhanced

name: Nobunaga's Ambition: Awakening - Complete Edition
summary: A complete edition of the game with various add-on content and new scenarios.

name: Fast Fusion
summary:
The fastest racing game you may have ever experienced! Non stop adrenaline pumping action at 60 fps in up to 4K HDR.

FAST Fusion vehicles are equipped with antigravity hyper jump technology. Cut corners and get ahead of your oppenents by jumping and boosting over them.

Create hundreds of new Racing machines by fusing your favorite vehicles.

Zoom through Redwood Forest, Alpine peaks, futuristic cities and many more breathtaking landscapes.

Play with smooth motion controls, enjoy immersive HD Rumble and customize the buttons.

name: Arcade Archives 2: Ridge Racer
summary:
A port of Ridge Racer, a racing game released by Bandai in 1993. It was originally released in arcades for the Namco System 22 hardware.

The game has four modes to choose from, including three difficulty levels – Novice, Intermediate, and Advanced - as well as T. T. (Time Trial), where players compete one-on-one against a rival car to achieve the best time.

Additionally, a DX version featuring support for an H-shifter and clutch is also included.

name: Kirby Air Riders
summary:
Kirby Air Riders is the long-awaited sequel to Kirby Air Ride on the Gamecube.

Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for competition! Take on your rivals in frantic arena battles or fast-paced races on the ground and in the air. Use the Boost Charge button to brake and control your turns as your machine automatically fights for top speed. Fill your Boost Charge Gauge as you drift around the bend and release it to trigger an explosive dash!

name: Donkey Kong Bananza
summary: Donkey Kong Bananza is exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2! Explore a vast underground world—by smashing your way through it! Bash, throw, and climb through just about anything in DK’s brand-new 3D platforming action-adventure game!

name: Tamagotchi Plaza: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
summary:
The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Tamagotchi Plaza adds three exclusive shops that can be played with mouse controls.

Become a shopkeeper in Tamahiko Town. Engage with more than 100 Tamagotchi as they open, customize and grow more than a dozen different shops and improve your reputation with them in town.

name: Street Fighter 6: Years 1-2 - Fighters Edition
summary:
It’s time to hit the streets! With tons of single player and multiplayer content, Street Fighter 6 Years 1-2 Fighters Edition is the ideal way to play the next evolution of the series.

name: Tiny Auto Knights
summary: An asynchronous PvP Auto Battler where you have to recruit and upgrade heroes and place them strategically on the battlefield to compete against other players.

name: Witchy Business
summary: Manage your very own Witchcraft Shop. This is a job simulator game where you brew potions for your customers, collect oddities, grow flowers in your garden, upgrade your alchemy station, and thrive.

name: Red Rogue Sea
summary: Red Rogue Sea is a roguelike strategy game that puts you in the shoes of a pirate captain and their crew. Manage your vessel as you sail through the treacherous waters of the archipelago, interact with the scum that inhabit it, and engage in battle using a tactical deck-building system.

name: Fisher Haven
summary: Fisher Haven is an immersive fishing adventure where you compete in the island's annual competition. Upgrade your gear, discover unique baits, and form alliances with fellow fishers to maximize your chances of victory. Explore diverse zones, catch over 100 fish types, and hunt down 7 rare species in this relaxing yet competitive fishing experience. Will you become the island’s ultimate fishing champion?

name: Super Mariomon
summary: Super Mariomon is a passionate community-driven project that blends the iconic charm of Super Mario with the strategic gameplay of Pokémon. Experience familiar faces like Mario, Luigi, Bowser, and more, now as unique and collectible Mariomon. Battle your way through reimagined regions, challenge familiar foes, and become the ultimate Mariomon Master

name: Lumo 2
summary: The isometric icon is back in the sequel to 2016’s arcade-adventure hit, Lumo. Experience a brand-new adventure of shifting dimensions and new perspectives, with gameplay that never stops evolving.

name: The Harmony Chronicles: Cat Out of the Bag - Collector’s Edition
summary: Help Mona save the kingdom old kingdom!

name: MoteMancer
summary: Automate across six Elemental planes, each with unique logistical tools. Infuse ingredients, craft alchemical structures, and uncover elegant solutions through experimentation - cultivating a garden of possibility, one discovery at a time.

name: Cloverpit
summary:
You wake up in a rusty, narrow cell, standing over a dangerously unstable grate.

Someone has kidnapped you, demanding payment, and your only way out is to play the Slot Machine and pay off your debt.

Don’t let yourself fall —literally— into ruin!

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 11
summary: The pack is back! The Jackbox Party Pack 11 transports your game night with 5 new mind-bending party games. Battle monsters with team-based trivia, sleuth through social clues, destroy wholesome jokes, create the kookiest of cookies, and noise-make your way through endless timelines of fun!

name: Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC
summary: Get ready for adrenaline-fueled racing fun as you climb your way through the motorsports ranks in pure arcade style! Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC is all about speed and pushing your driving skills to the limit.

name: Exo-Calibre
summary: Meet the Ex-Calibre Knights, elite pilots in state-of-the-art exo-mechs, defending peace, justice and hope across the world! The Exo-Tech corporation is dedicated to developing advanced weapons and defenses to aid humanity, but when AI drones go haywire and start attacking the populous, it’s up to you to take control of the Ex-Calibre Knights and restore order by any means necessary!

name: Tiny Pixels Vol. 2: Stormy Knights
summary: Step into the armored boots of an overzealous knight as you fight across the continent rescuing princesses from monstrous captors in Stormy Knights! Strategic real-time combat ensues as you storm the halls of each castle in side-scrolling pixel art style, from medieval Europe and mystical Persia to feudal Japan and more, all accompanied by an original retro soundtrack!
