name: Super Stream-Bara
summary: CAPPA, a hero from capybara legend, needs your help! Your mission: free every capybara in the world from the evil clutches of Capy Land. But wait... who is that mysterious Stream-Bara lurking in the corner of the screen?

name: Transporter
summary: Transporter is a platformer racing game. Your goal is to preserve your goods, maintain balance, and overcome obstacles with at least one item left at the finish line. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

name: My Journey
summary: This is a Interactive Live-Action Game. You will travel back in time to become a noble Highness and experience the local customs and practices of ancient times. A series of your choices will influence the development trajectory of this world.

name: Wortgewandt
summary:
Wortgewandt is all about the art of forming meaningful words from a jumble of letters in the shortest possible time.
The game is specifically tailored to the German-speaking world – including the common Anglicisms that are also omnipresent in German.

name: Gost! Buster
summary: Gost! Buster is a horror game in the genre of psychological thriller, inspired by Russian mythology. You will have to become a ghost hunter, explore the places where the evil dwells, collect clues, determine the type of ghost and conduct exorcism rituals. Use special equipment, fix anomalies and uncover the secrets of the otherworld to rid the world of evil entities forever.

name: Bloodbark
summary: Bloodbark is a short horror game based on the works of Eduardo Valdés-Hevia, a known horror artist. While specially inspired on his artwork "Bloodbark", many of his other works are also featured on this game.

name: Cradle of Nightmare : Flowers to you
summary: Cradle of Nightmares: Flowers for You is an ATB turn-based game based on combat adventures made by RPGMaker. Players will take on the role of a high school student named Le Qing, who will fall into the dark and gloomy "second world" and embark on a journey to end the filthy fate of mankind.

name: Enshrouded: Thralls of Twilight
summary: Here we are with our sixth update! We’re thrilled to bring you Thralls of Twilight, a new update designed to make the Shroud more inviting and more dangerous than ever, adding some new gameplay mechanics, as well as a huge number of new locations to explore, and a bunch of gameplay improvements and additions. We've also updated a slew of locations and points of interest across the world, and as always, a bunch of miscellaneous other fixes and improvements!

name: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect x Dead Cells
summary:
New Playable Character (Prototype) – The Prisoner
Step into the boots of the iconic Prisoner from Dead Cells, wield 27 signature weapons, skills and mutations from the original game as well as 20+ combo variants that pay tribute to other Dead Cells’ iconic gears.
Exclusive Challenge Biome
Dive into a new roguevania-inspired challenge biome built for The Prisoner, where Dead Cells’ fast, fluid combat meets BBEE’s satisfying combos!

name: X4: Foundations - Diplomacy Update
summary: At the core of the 8.00 update for X4: Foundations is the new Diplomacy system, which will make the sandbox and economy simulation elements of X4: Foundations shine in new ways. The Diplomacy system is a deeply integrated new gameplay feature, built around three main components: A new embassy facility, a new class of hireable NPCs (Agents) who can be specialized in negotiation or espionage, and the ability to trigger and influence dynamic diplomatic standing between NPC factions.

name: Carimara: Beneath the Forlorn Limbs
summary: You are the Carimara, and your mission is to conjure a ghost by answering their questions using your cards. A short and creepy fairytale, full of surprises and mysteries.

name: Void/Breaker
summary: VOID/BREAKER is an Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through environmental destruction/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

name: Driving Life
summary: Driving Life is a hardcore driving survival game set in rural America. Earn money by driving manual cars, vans, and trucks, transport tourists, pay rent, buy fuel, and survive on a tight budget. Every dollar counts - spend wisely or go broke!

name: Chained Backrooms
summary: CHAINED BACKROOMS is a horror game where players are chained together, forced to survive and explore procedurally generated Backrooms levels. Only coordinated teamwork can help avoid dangers and find an escape. Co-op for 1-4 players.

name: Kamitsubaki Academy Newspaper Club
summary: You wake up with amnesia in Kamitsubaki City, a city with a giant tower in its center. There, you meet a girl named Kafu Morisaki, and begin participating at the Kamitsubaki Academy Newspaper Club at her invitation.

name: Renegade Rush
summary: Renegade Rush is a survivor-style roguelike featuring deep upgrade systems, strategic exploration, and dynamic weapon builds. Stay aware of your position in the universe—venture out to hunt and discover, but don’t stray too far from home unless you're prepared for the dangers ahead.

name: The Horde Wants You Dead
summary: The Horde Wants You Dead is a casual, top-down shooter with 4-player online co-op. Ambushed by an angry horde, you and your friends face a fight for survival against thousands of relentless enemies!

name: Cosmolace
summary: A narrative-driven puzzle game that combines "optical illusions" with "single-stroke puzzle" as its theme. Players rotate their perspective in a 3D space, using optical illusions to connect vertexes and segments, completing the patterns in each level with a single stroke.

name: Shrink Rooms
summary: Run! The rooms are shrinking! A puzzle game Demo about escaping from shrinking rooms. Every step counts if you want to make it out alive! Complete box-pushing puzzles within a limited number of steps or be crushed into a puddle of meat by the pressing walls of the level!

name: Bunny
summary: "BUNNY" is a side-scrolling action game where Bunny and Smallbird embark on an adventure to find their friends. Control Bunny as you navigate through stages, overcoming obstacles and squeezing through walls. There's no game over, so everyone can play through to the end.

name: Crescent Tower
summary: Aspire to reach the top of Crescent Tower that appears just once every 50 years! An authentic 8-bit style dungeon crawler RPG with a retro level of difficulty, where you repeatedly explore, level up, and traverse dungeons!

name: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond
summary: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players.

name: Hyke: Northern Light(s)
summary: The young witch Hyke's adventure begins! A thrilling 2D top-down action pixel RPG. Relax and camp with your companions!

name: Dead Format
summary: Dead Format is a survival horror game set in iconic film eras. It's 1990s Scotland, and your brother has gone missing after becoming obsessed with a mysterious new VHS format. Follow his trail through the tapes and uncover why the government wants to ban "Video Ghastlies".

name: Uncanny Tales: Cold Road
summary: Uncanny Tales is an episodic horror series where the real terror comes not from monsters or the supernatural, but from people. Each episode is a new unsettling story inspired by real fears and eerie situations from everyday life.

name: Quiver & Die
summary:
Quiver and Die is a medieval top down zombie shooter where you play as an archer in a zombie infested dark fantasy world.

With beautiful, hand drawn art and carefully hand crafted levels, Quiver and Die aims to provide a fun, action-packed and visually stunning gameplay experience.

name: Skyblocker
summary: Skyblocker is a 3D puzzle game in which players build towers from toy blocks and try to set a global high score while battling wind and weather. It also features a "zen" mode with no scoring or time constraints, so the player can build, relax, and enjoy multiple different picturesque locales.

name: Soul Mates
summary: You’re trapped inside a haunted house, stalked by angry ghosts. To survive, you’ll have to run, hide, strategize, give gifts, chat, flirt… Wait, what kind of game is this? Oh right, it’s a point-and-click survival horror dating sim!

name: Fish Stick Protocol
summary: Gather up to 8 players and dive into chaotic procedural dimensions to collect artifacts for the Owner's peculiar galleries.

name: Twinkleby
summary: Twinkleby is a cozy decoration game where you map out an archipelago of floating islands and build dioramas for a society of spacefaring neighbours. Expand your collection, discover antique secrets, decorate, and when you change your mind – evict everyone and throw their furniture into space!

name: AFL 26
summary: Get ready for the future of footy with AFL 26. Feel every hit, hear every roar, and live every moment with unmatched authenticity and intensity. From the first bounce to the final siren, the action is fast, fierce, and true to the game. With lifelike gameplay, roaring crowds, expert commentary, and all the drama of real AFL, you’re not just watching the game — you’re in it. This is footy, redefined.

name: The Royal Writ
summary:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honor the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of diverse warriors with interesting abilities that shape your strategy. Lead an army of adorable yet battle-hardened animals. Your ranks may comprise a frail and wounded flamingo, a short sighted chicken bowman, or even a crafty lizard who cheats death by only losing its tail! From the renegade red ants to the food taster cow, every card in your deck has a personality and purpose.

As they march toward glory or death, their individual stories become part of your kingdom's legacy, and their sacrifices will never be forgotten. You may even come across some peculiar creatures on your journey, like the crazed mantis dentist, the goat tactician or the impatient boar shopkeeper - just don’t ask them where they got their credentials.

name: Ninja Party
summary: Ninja Party is a free parkour action game from the creators of Shadow Fight and Vector. Compete with other players in fun challenges for the title of the best ninja!

name: The Boba Teashop
summary: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to grow your business.

name: Sejm The Game
summary: Become a member of the Polish parliament, create a powerful party and lead it to victory - get a taste of power and don't let anyone take it away from you!

name: Pet Hero vs. Zombie
summary:
The zombie apocalypse is here! Choose your animal warrior - a brave cat with a gun, a mighty crocodile with a bazooka or a bold chicken with a revolver! More heroes are waiting to be unlocked.

Face endless hordes of zombies, fight for survival and collect gold coins to upgrade your weapons and unlock new characters and maps. Each battle is a test of skill and endurance - how long can you survive?

name: Caput Mortum
summary: Caput Mortum is a short first-person horror experience inspired by retro 3D dungeon crawlers and survival horror games. It focuses on exploration and atmosphere while providing puzzles, simple combat, and light resource management.

name: That Time I Found a Box
summary:
“That Time I Found a Box” is a roguelike deckbuilder where cards have no cost and are blank slates for you to build, upgrade and modify as you like. Choose carefully when to play them and when / how to improve them.

The focus is deep strategic card building and deck building with very few moments of there being only one obvious play available, however keeping things simple to understand from moment to moment.

You open a mysterious box of magical cards that intertwines your fate with three powerful beings. The cards are blank slates that you must refine and use to gain the favor of the powerful beings, lest they come after you. Watch your back - your life may depend on it!

name: Dawn of Ages
summary:
At the dawn of medieval history, build your castle and evolve your army using real weapons and armor from ages past. March against hostile civilizations as you re-trace the steps of history. Engage your rivals and crush their empires in battle!

️No Dragons, No Magic, Not Now, Not Ever.

Dawn of Ages is a game that’s grounded in historical accuracy. No fantasy creatures, no mystical spells, just real, historical empires and war strategy games like no other. Every weapon, armor, and tactic you use is based on the reality of ancient battlefields.

name: Enormosword
summary: The prequel to the redeveloped Ginormo Sword. An early showcase of what is to come.

name: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown
summary:
Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown is an action-adventure platformer game, inspired by the Metroidvania genre and set in a mythological Persian world.

Play an epic adventure as Sargon, an extraordinary and fearless young hero. Summoned by Queen Thomyris with your fellow brothers-in-arms, the Immortals, you are sent on a rescue mission to save her son: Prince Ghassan.

The trail leads you to Mount Qaf, the ancient city of Gods, now cursed and filled with time-corrupted enemies and inhospitable mythological creatures.

To fulfill your quest, you will have to learn to master unique Time Powers, combat and platforming skills to perform deadly combos to defeat your enemies and restore the world's balance.

name: Varlet
summary: To be a "leader" that guides others forward, or to be an uncompromising "ruler"...VARLET is a school life RPG where, through encounters with troubled boys and girls who are also searching for themselves, you begin to uncover a version of yourself you never knew existed.

name: Hex Blast
summary: Hex Blast is a horde survival x roguelike deckbuilder where you strategize on a hex grid, chaining explosive card combos to wipe out cyber hordes. Build your deck, collect overclocked chips, and discover the most broken builds to annihilate cyber threats—before they overwhelm you.

name: Femboy Futa House
summary: Congratulations, you've been accepted to the College of Magical Arts! Immerse yourself in a rich student life full of magic, passion, and adventure. Meet the eccentric residents of dorm 9 ¾ and get to know them as closely as you can...

name: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance
summary: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance expands the Blue Protocol universe with a vibrant MMORPG experience. Create your own hero, team up for strategic raids, or simply relax and have fun with friends fishing, crafting, and endless exploration. Adventure awaits!

name: Nidana
summary: She continues to dream. A first-person dream simulator where you explore a corner of a dream.

name: Genshin Impact: Paralogism
summary:
Version 5.6 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Escoffier and Ifa
• New main story quest: "Interlude Chapter: Act IV - Paralogism"
• New story quest for Escoffier
• New main event: Whirling Waltz
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

name: Amanda the Adventurer 3
summary: In the thrilling conclusion of the Amanda the Adventurer trilogy, follow Riley as they uncover the ultimate secrets behind Amanda, Hameln, and mysteries that have plagued Kensdale for decades.

name: Poco
summary:
Poco is a 2D/3D hybrid point-and-click adventure game where you play as Poco, a two-inch tall clown who is banished from a giant walking circus, and left to fend for themselves in the undergrowth of the Below World, where they befriend and enlist the help of the local homunculus population to build a rocket.

Explore the beautiful, cluttered Below World... Where everything broken, lost, or unwanted from the Worlds Above comes to decay.

name: Beyond the Grove
summary: Summon nature’s army in this charming RTS-inspired autobattler. With your troop of mushroom warriors and over 50 unique elemental Golems by your side, command your fun-guy forces to push back the corruption beyond your grove. Strategize, adapt, and overcome!

name: Joe Rules: Reloaded
summary: Joe Rules: Reloaded is a top-down shooter game where you solve puzzles, kill enemies and progress through progressively difficult levels!

name: Idle Boss Rush
summary: Slay giant bosses and turn the hollow wasteland into the almighty kingdom! Endlessly rewarding incremental game where you collect fountains of rare loot, unleash crazy combos and watch the monsters fall under your knees. Boss Rush that keeps on going when you're gone!

name: Jump the Track
summary: You're Sam, a young dreamer struggling in the gig economy. However, tonight may change everything. In this absurd comedy, fight your inner battles, rally your forces, and get ready to overthrow the system!

name: Mycopunk
summary: A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

name: Dream Slayers
summary:
Enter the twisted realms of Dream Slayers, a thrilling extraction RPG where reality and nightmare collide. In this dark fantasy world, players become elite warriors known as Dream Slayers, tasked with venturing into surreal dreamscapes to hunt fearsome creatures, reclaim lost relics, and escape before the dream consumes them.

Armed with a diverse arsenal of medieval-themed weapons—swords, axes, bows, and arcane tools—you must strategize every encounter. Each run offers new dangers and unexpected rewards as you navigate treacherous environments, solve cryptic puzzles, and face off against powerful bosses that embody the deepest fears of humanity.

Team up with friends or venture solo, balancing risk versus reward in high-stakes extractions. Will you grab the treasure and escape in time, or be trapped in an endless nightmare?

name: Mythscroll
summary: Mythscroll is a fantasy RPG where every choice, encounter, and stat check shapes your journey. Explore the world, equip powerful weapons, master spells, and survive dynamic text-driven adventures, with D&D-inspired character building, turn-based combat, and branching outcomes.

name: Backseat Drivers
summary: Test your friendship in Backseat Drivers, the ultimate co-op driving disaster. One drives, one shouts directions, and your car belongs in the junkyard. Bump, crash, and scream your way through town as your clunker yeets into every possible obstacle. Yelling is inevitable. Apologies are optional.

name: Project Motor Racing
summary: All the passion, beauty & intensity of pro motorsport merging the most iconic cars & circuits with a new benchmark in handling performance.

name: Brave x Junction
summary: Obtain weapons, draw cards! Do you leave it to chance or trickery? A brand-new experience, a blackjack RPG!

name: MindMessenger
summary: Imagine a digital escape room in which you communicate with AI characters via a familiar messenger interface - sometimes you have to outwit them, sometimes convince them or simply combine cleverly to discover new paths and hidden successes in the scenario. The advanced AI technology gives you complete freedom in your responses - no predefined dialog options, but real conversations just like in real life.

name: Trails
summary:
TRAILS is a cozy puzzle game in which players guide sandships across a crumbling desert to reach isolated outposts.

Players draw lines on a grid in order to plot the movement of ships that cannot selfintersect or visit a tile twice. When done drawing they can start the simulation and see the outcome their routs produced. If the ships reach their goal without collision and while satisfying all victory conditions they win and advance to the next level. Over the course of the game more and more interacting mechanics get added to the game, requiring players to supply outposts with vital cargo, unlock new passages, juggle items, avoid hostile drones and support allied ships.

name: Orbs Orbs Orbs
summary: Orbs Orbs Orbs is a vibrant 2D precision clicker game. Clear the board with a white ring, master six orb types, and navigate the dynamic physics in a playful blend of relaxation and strategy.

name: Formula Legends
summary: From the golden age to the modern era, race through time in Formula Legends. Master reimagined circuits, command legendary cars, and chase glory across decades of motorsport history. A love letter to Formula racing, where speed, skill, and strategy define the champion.

name: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show
summary: The incredible Mr. Rabbit invites you all to a mysterious magic show! Celebrate 10 years of Rusty Lake with a new free-to-play point-and-click adventure that promises to delight and… shock you with its sleight of hand!

name: My Card Is Better Than Your Card!
summary: Become the coolest kid of the playground in this playful roguelike deckbuilder. Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder!

name: Irem Collection: Volume 3
summary:
Release Date: 2025

* Limited to a maximum of 4,000 copies worldwide
* Manual included
* Mr. Heli/Battle Chopper (Arcade, PC Engine). Guide a cute heli through winding levels and buy upgrades in a shop along the way. Mr. Heli features fresh gameplay and beautiful graphics.
* Mystic Riders (Arcade). A quirky horizontal Shooter in a bright fantasy setting with wizards as protagonists.
* Dragon Breed (Arcade). Featuring impressive graphics and gameplay reminiscent of R-Type, ride your invincible dragon through a dark fantasy world.

name: Oscuro Blossom's Glow
summary: Join Selene in a charming platforming and puzzle adventure, where her ability to absorb and emit light from various flowers is key to activating mechanisms, overcoming obstacles, and navigating through environments that adjust depending on how you wield the light.

name: Lonely House
summary: Lonely House is a cozy little game about home decorating. It's just you, pleasant music, and a solitary building at a crossroads. Decorate it to your liking and forget about your troubles.

name: Playtown 3
summary: Thirteen years later, Playtown reopens, but it's no longer just a playground. Uncover the dark rise of the enigmatic E.Y.E. Order, battle terrifying mutated mascots, and stop Hexcor before his plan destroys everything. The truth lies beneath. Survive the nightmare. End the Order.

name: Madden NFL 26
summary: Dominate the league in EA SPORTS Madden NFL 26.

name: Misery
summary: Misery is a 1–5 player co-op survival game set in a nuclear disaster zone. Here, every day is a struggle: search radioactive ruins for resources, build your bunker, craft weapons, and explore a weird, procedurally-generated world with your friends. Beware of anomalies, monsters, and armed bandits.

name: Diceball
summary: Roll the dice and dominate in Diceball, a turn-based sports strategy game where luck meets skill. Guide your team through 10 consecutive wins to claim the championship. Unlock 8 unique teams, collect powerful upgrades at the Concession Stand, and build your team on your way to victory.

name: S.p.l.i.t
summary: A short psychological horror game, where you attempt to gain root access into an unethical superstructure.

name: The Demons Told Me to Make This Game
summary: Welcome to Red Hives, a lovely Midwestern town infested with demons. You're a little spirit stuck in a time loop, your only way to interact with the world is by possessing people and whispering into their ears. Explore timelines, solve mysteries, and please, try to keep your hosts alive...

name: The Quintessential Princesses: Fantasy, Abyss, and Magic Academy
summary: Your goal is to become the private tutor of five underperforming quintuplets on the verge of flunking out of the Magic Academy, and guide them toward graduation.

name: Gears of War: Reloaded
summary: The original Gears of War returns, faithfully remastered and natively optimized for more platforms than ever before as Gears of War: Reloaded. Experience the origins of one of gaming’s most acclaimed franchises like never before. Featuring 4K resolution, up to 120 FPS support, and the ultimate multiplayer experience with cross-progression and cross-play, across all platforms, this is the definitive way to experience the game that started it all.

name: Byakko: Shijin Butai Enrenki
summary:
It is the first year of the Genji era. A period of disorder that led to the downfall of the Edo shogunate.

The protagonist, born in the Aizu provincial family of samurai, lost her elder brother to war, and became orphaned at the age of sixteen.

Engulfed in sadness, she fell asleep one night whilst hugging the blade her brother disemboweled himself with.

Suddenly, a deity calling itself Byakko appeared in her dreams—

Byakko informed her that Aizu will eventually lose the war, and bestowed upon her a single mission:

"With this gun, please prevent the 'Tragedy of the Youth' from ever taking place.
If you are able to accomplish this, I shall grant any wish of yours on the following dawn."

When she awoke, her brother's blade had changed into a gun—

Three years later, the protagonist, who had become an expert in artillery, was led to meet with her comrades-in-arms, whom she will share her fate with.

Will the ending they reach be one of tragedy, glory, or perhaps...

—This is a story of the fight against a tragic history.

name: Cat Named Mojave
summary: Stranded in the desert, your only hope of escaping rests in a strange Catman. His one request: hunt down surreal creatures, skin them, and chop them up so he can keep them as trophies. In this uncanny place, Death will become all too familiar.

name: Destiny 2: The Edge of Fate
summary: The first chapter of a new Destiny saga is here. Guardians will venture into the unknown, where the mysteries of the cosmos – and The Nine – await.

name: Buggos 2
summary: Buggos 2 is a horde-based auto-battler where players command a sentient hivemind to evolve and deploy massive swarms of alien insects against human forces. The game features permanent upgrades, specialized unit types, and strategic control of the battlefield to overwhelm increasingly advanced enemies.

name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - The Three Kingdoms
summary: Journey across a thousand years of Chinese history and dive into the epic Romance of the Three Kingdoms with the latest expansion for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - where history and legend collide in a battle for supremacy.

name: She's Leaving
summary: Put your forensic skills to the test in this brand new first person survival horror, She's Leaving. Play as Charles Dalton, a blood spatter analyst tasked with the most gruesome crime scene of his life. Can you survive a night in House Haywood?

name: Hey, Girlie!
summary: "Hey, Girlie!" is a free visual novel dating sim created by fans of Dimension 20's Fantasy High. Play as chosen cleric Kristen Applebees and attempt to romance six sapphic characters: Tracker, Gertie, Kipperlilly, Fig, Lucy, and Naradriel.

name: Mafia: The Old Country Deluxe Edition
summary:
Mafia: The Old Country is a third-person action-adventure game set in early 1900s Sicily. It follows Enzo Favara, a former forced laborer who joins the Torrisi crime family in search of a better life and becomes involved in the violent world of organized crime.

The game follows a linear narrative structure and combines gunfights, knife combat, stealth, and exploration. Enzo travels across Sicilian towns and countryside on foot, horseback, and in period automobiles while carrying out assignments for the Torrisi family.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full base game
• Padrino Pack:
- "Lupara Speciale" shotgun
- "Vendetti Speciale" pistol
- "Immortale" charm
- "Padrino" outfit
- "Stiletto Speciale" knife
- "Eckhart Speciale" limousine
- "Cosimo" horse and accessories
• Gatto Nero Pack:
- "Bodeo Nero" pistol
- "Velocità" charm
- "Gatto Nero" outfit
- "Carozella Nero" race car
• Bonus materials:
- Digital artbook
- Original score

name: Europa Universalis V
summary: Use war, trade or diplomacy to satisfy your grandest ambitions and dominate five centuries of history in the newest version of Europa Universalis, Paradox Interactive's flagship historical grand strategy game.

name: Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition
summary: A new action-horror story set in the iconic Alien universe. Play as rogue Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks, sent to investigate a blacksite on Purdan. Fight and survive using your skill, reflexes, and determination against a deadly Xenomorph incursion in this gripping first chapter of a two-part saga.

name: Destiny 2: Renegades
summary: Dive into the criminal underworld and take down an evil empire. Venture into a lawless frontier and reveal deeper mysteries about a new Dredgen in Sol. Build your power, credits, and notoriety.

name: Defender's Dynasty
summary: A 2D Strategic Base Defender game set in Medieval times. As relentless Waves of enemy forces threaten your Stronghold, you must gather Resources, Fortify your Defenses and lead your Rebellion. Prepare to strengthen your Base and manage your Resources. But beaware of the Storms!

name: Honkai: Star Rail - The Fall at Dawn’s Rise
summary:
Version 3.3 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Hyacine and Cypher
• New Trailblaze Mission: "The Fall at Dawn’s Rise"
• New areas: Fortress of Dome and Cloudedge Bastion Ruins
• …and more!

name: Pigface
summary: You wake up with an explosive headache in a pool of your own blood. You're Exit, a terrible woman whose awful past has finally caught up to her. Fulfill contracts for the people who drilled into your skull — guns-blazing, slow and tactical — it doesn’t matter. They know you’ll do whatever it takes.

name: Mini Painter
summary:
Mini Painter is a cozy desktop idle game about finding balance between work and rest.
Immerse yourself in a meditative world where a tiny artist paints miniature figures, decorates his home, and learns to take care of himself.

name: Rock and Scroll
summary: In Rock and Scroll you follow Sisyphus who is now cursed to be the very boulder he pushed up the mountain, as he tries to outwit the gods one last time in this literal side scroller platform game.

name: Self Simulated
summary: Self Simulated is a fast-paced precision platformer for the Game Boy Color. Play as a robotic version of yourself and navigate over 100 handcrafted levels filled with enemies, hazards, and glitch-filled dangers. Uncover your past and master tight, responsive controls designed for fast retries and fluid movement.

name: Spooky Express
summary: Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park! Transport monsters to their destinations — but don’t let them bite the passengers or you’ll have a grave problem.

name: Mimesis
summary: A co-op survival horror game. When the cursed rain falls, 'Mimesis' appear, perfectly imitating your teammates, bringing a new level of tension you've never experienced before.

name: House Builder 2
summary: In House Builder 2 you build your dream constructions with friends or alone in a vibrant, low-poly open world! Buy materials for work, load it up, and drive to your next job in the ultimate co-op construction adventure!

name: Unsent
summary:
Unsent is a wacky 3D platformer set in a labyrinthine 1970’s inspired post office.

Freshly out of work, Valentine has turned to his latest employment opportunity: a postman at the Unsentiment Department. Jump, dash, and fight your way through your postal route as you deliver letters that were never meant to be Unsent.

Throughout your journey as a postman, it's your job to deliver letters that have slipped from the human realm into the Unsentiment Department. Valentine's mail route will bring him from dilapidated mansions to bleak suburban neighborhoods in his quest to provide closure to those who never received their letters.

name: Operation Night Strikers
summary: Taito's 80's arcade hits hit back! Four milestones of the 80s arcade movement in one action-packed compilation!

name: Groove Coaster: Future Performers
summary: Groove Coaster: Future Performers, unlike previous entries in the Groove Coaster series, is a completely new game redesigned from the ground up. New elements have been introduced across all aspects of the game, including controls, music score, and the world setting. Do not miss this all-new Groove Coaster.

name: Fischer's Fishing Journey
summary: Put Fischer on your desktop as your ultimate study and work buddy. He'll fish quietly in the corner, taking care of it all—you just drop in occasionally to collect your rewards, unlock new fish, upgrade your rod, while enjoying that calming, healing atmosphere.

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chornobyl - Enhanced Edition
summary: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chornobyl, the first chapter of the Legends of the Zone Trilogy, which started it all. Welcome to the former exclusion territory near the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant… the most dangerous place on Earth. Play as The Marked One, face sinister mysteries, radiation-soaked anomalous threats and moral dilemmas, as your decisions determine your destiny in this immersive dark sci-fi saga.

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat - Enhanced Edition
summary: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat follows the story of special service agent Major Degtyarev as he investigates the fate of a lost expedition. Rich with colorful characters, memorable side stories, and the spirit of true freedom, this chapter delivers a powerful and unforgettable conclusion to the Legends of the Zone Trilogy.

name: Side Effects
summary: Side Effects is a horror game that attempts to re-design Russian Roulette, replacing the gun and bullets with pills.

name: Night Swarm
summary: Rise as a young vampire, earn your name, and gather powerful allies. In this survivor-like auto-shooter, battle relentless werewolf hordes, grow your strength, build your pack, and dominate the night.

name: BrightGunner
summary: BrightGunner is a innovative fast-paced first person shooter game.simplicity and refreshment, the three major design concepts are: diversified gameplay, mild Rogue mechanism, and no interface design style.

name: Street Fighter 6
summary: The Switch 2 version of Street Fighter 6 runs with enhanced visuals and stable performance, offering both online and local multiplayer options. It also includes exclusive modes like Local Wireless One-on-One and Avatar Matches. Two new motion-based modes, Gyro Battle and Calorie Contest, use Joy-Con controls for more active, movement-based gameplay. Amiibo support allows players to unlock cosmetics and save control or outfit settings. All core modes—Fighting Ground, World Tour, and Battle Hub—are included, along with real-time commentary, the Drive Gauge system, and a roster of 18 fighters.

name: Blasfemia
summary: Blasfemia is a first-person horror game. You are trapped in a seemingly normal apartment but realize early on that you're not alone. Explore a handcrafted, detail rich environment in a tense and terrifying atmosphere and try to find a way out before an ominous entity gets to you.

name: Dominova
summary: Collect and chain dominoes together: the longer the chain, the higher you score. Amplify your score-breaking engine through various upgrades, while also navigating through a volatile board full of hazards and loot in this oddly satisfying domino deckbuilder.

name: Kaiju No. 8: The Game
summary:
Crush colossal Kaiju with a game-changing blow! Experience exhilarating attacks with intuitive controls! Explore the world of Kaiju No. 8, recreated with stunning visuals!

Based on the global hit anime, adapted from the Shonen Jump+ sensation, KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME brings you into the heart of the action! Witness epic battles between the Japan Anti-Kaiju Defense Force and cataclysmic Kaiju, all rendered in breathtaking graphics!

name: Syberia: Remastered
summary: More than 20 years after its original release, Syberia is reborn in a fully modernized version. Rediscover its iconic locations and unforgettable characters through a stunning visual overhaul, redesigned gameplay, and the same captivating storytelling that made it a classic.

name: The New Flesh
summary: Explore the strange world within the screen in this ambient exploration experience featuring the music of Red Vox.

name: Chamber X
summary:
"CHAMBER X" is a gripping puzzle-based horror mystery game where every locked door holds a secret waiting to be uncovered.
As you navigate through eerie rooms and solve intricate puzzles, you'll uncover dark truths and hidden clues to escape an ever-tightening grip of danger.
Time is running out, and the only way to survive is to solve the riddles and escape before the walls close in.

name: Dog Witch
summary: Dog Witch is a roguelike deckbuilder where your spells are fueled by enchanted dice. Combine over 150 unique items to forge ever-evolving strategies, perfect synergy combos, summon minions, and tackle an endless range of bizarre foes.

name: The Soul Stone War 3
summary: By the power of your Soul Stone and the strength of your own indomitable soul, uncover secrets held in blood and lead the charge that will change the world. A text-based fantasy novel, 260,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

name: Shuten Order
summary:
"168 remaining until the end of the world..."

Humanity is approaching its end. A sudden dismemberment murder of the leader of a religious nation that advocates an apocalyptic ideology... Five adventure games are combined into one, centered around a suspenseful story full of mystery and intrigue.

name: Castle of Heart: Retold
summary: Introducing Castle of Heart: Retold, a completely reworked version of the challenging action platformer that had been exclusive to the Nintendo Switch. The tweaks include rewritten dialog, reworked cutscenes, remixed music, graphics and animation changes, improved gameplay and UI, changed endings, and more.

name: Atomfall: Wicked Isle
summary:
The Wicked Isle story expansion is set on Midsummer Island. To get there, players must speak to the boat-keeper in Wyndham Village, who provides the first Lead.

Located near the Windscale Atom Plant, Midsummer has higher infection levels and introduces new enemies like pirate bandits and infected druids. Players can find new weapons, including a Blunderbuss, bow, daggers, the Beekeeper’s Staff, unlock new skills and an upgraded metal detector.

Leads found on the island open new story paths and possible alternate endings to Atomfall.

name: All-front Assault
summary: This is a game where players manipulate and command a commander from a customized perspective, controlling an entire team to combat alien creatures.

name: Toy Escape
summary: Toy Escape is a co-op game for up to 4 players where you play as a small toy trying to climb your way through a giant house to reach the rooftop and escape. Jump, climb, and find your way out in this fun, toy-sized adventure!

name: Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi
summary: Welcome to Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi! This is a relaxing and enjoyable idle fishing game that can sit at the bottom or any corner of your screen, allowing you to enjoy a leisurely sea fishing time in your busy life.

name: Night Shift
summary: Feeling hungry? Our pizza will make you never hungry again. Apply today for the prestigious Night Shift at our beloved 24/7 pizza parlor. Clean up, clock in, and definitely don’t look out the windows.

name: Sizzle & Stack
summary:
Sizzle & Stack is a fast-paced, card-based cooking simulator where deck-building meets restaurant chaos. Inspired by Stacklands, this unique twist on the culinary genre puts you in charge of a growing kitchen where every dish, upgrade, and decision is made with cards.

Every day is a new puzzle. Stack ingredients, combine tools, manage tight spaces, and serve up delicious meals to increasingly demanding customers. Whether you're prepping a simple soup or assembling a gourmet masterpiece, timing, strategy, and resource management are your secret ingredients to success.

name: Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
summary: This is a top-down, auto-shooting roguelike that can be played entirely one-handed. Players take on the role of Pinocchio, fallen into a twisted dreamworld, collecting forbidden Dream Eggs that grant ever-changing offensive and survival abilities. Slaughter mutated fairy tale characters in endless nightmares!

name: Secrets of Blackrock Manor: Escape Room
summary: Find the hidden fortune of Blackrock Manor. Discover the truth about the family deaths. In this mysterious Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to find the hidden vault with the treasure. But you will find much more...

name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance
summary: Type like your life depends on it in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance! Brutally decimate hordes of daemonic scum with every keystroke, in this fast-paced rail shooter. None can stand against the might of your WPM (words-per-minute)!

name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector – Deeds of the Fallen
summary: Welcome to Warzone Chalnath — a volatile hotspot in the galaxy-wide conflict — where you take the battle to Thorakleo IV. Featuring 12 brand new missions and three new units for the Sisters of Battle.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition
summary: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition is the ultimate Dawn of War experience, featuring the original Dawn of War and all its expansions, along with enhanced visuals, an improved camera, and 64-bit platform support.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition
summary: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine returns. Enhanced for a new generation! Enjoy quality of life & graphical improvements that take the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine experience to the next level.

name: Dragons Reef
summary: Start sailing adventure by defending the Dragons Reef land from pirates, manage unique artifacts, customize character magic skills, watch out for underwater creatures, admire the beautiful foreign nature, get own dragon, collect loot. Top-down action RPG, tower defense and cartoon ships naval combat

name: Livber: Smoke and Mirrors
summary: A short psychological horror interactive story. Five years after vanishing without a trace, the woman you once called your lover writes from beyond the silence: "I will give birth to your child.” In three acts, descend into a fractured mindscape where obsession, memory, and myth intertwine.

name: Wrack: Reclamation
summary: Inspired by classics like DOOM and Quake, Wrack is an arcade-style FPS. Mow down enemies one after another, and become more powerful the more you kill. Amass a deadly arsenal, discover secret powers... and save your world!

name: Word Play
summary: Spell words, get upgrades, score points, and survive until the end. Every round is different. How far can you make it?

name: DarkRanger
summary: "Dark Ranger" is a light Rogue RPG. Veterans who have retired from the human battlefield have regained their glory in the secondary battlefield against monsters.

name: Jason: Coming of Age
summary: Play as a young man of 25 exploring love, temptations, and the mysterious power of attraction he possesses. Dive into an erotic, intense, and unpredictable world where every choice you make will shape your destiny.

name: Island Robot Farm
summary: Build a super large island with robots in this relaxing idle farm simulation game. Assign tasks to robots to plant, raise animals and build various buildings to expand your island. Even when you're busy, the game can run quietly at the corner or bottom of the screen and keep developing your farm.

name: Lighthouse of the Souls
summary: Lighthouse Of The Souls is a third-person action roguelite with RPG mechanics and realistic graphics. Face the challenges of a dark and supernatural world solo or in multiplayer co-op, where survival depends on your skill and strategy.

name: Slime Store Simulator
summary: Slime Store Simulator is a small casual game where you operate a store that sells cute slimes! Order a variety of different types of slimes, set your own prices, take payments, hire help, and expand the store.

name: ByteRogue
summary: ByteRogue is a minimalist tactical roguelike where you play as a wizard-thief. Use spells to outsmart security robots, manipulate the environment, and steal as much treasure as you can in each daring heist.

name: Hellbrella
summary: This is a fast-paced action roguelike where you are a Cat in a Raincoat fighting hordes of demons using an umbrella to survive!

name: Once Up
summary: Join Cliff Hanger, the elephant with the unique ability to latch on and become weightless! Use drawings from an old fairy tale book to create your own climbing paths, conquer tricky sections, and collect peanuts to unlock new levels.

name: City: Battle Ground
summary: A card strategy game inspired by the principles of Auto Chess and roguelike genres. Dive into a criminal beast-metropolis where cops, bikers, gangsters, zombies, and even superheroes battle for control of the streets. Build a crazy deck, combine faction abilities.

name: Mechwarrior 5: Clans - Ghost Bear Flash Storm
summary: Mech sim. DLC expansion to Mechwarrior 5 Clans

name: Mosaic of the Strange
summary: Mosaic of the Strange is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle. Help Special Agents Cullen and Brady investigate a bizarre murder, while discovering 125 real-world paranormal case files.

name: Abra-cooking-dabra
summary: Abra-Cooking-Dabra is a cooking card game. Manage ingredients and make British dishes to keep toves, borogoves, and mome raths fed. Meet timers and fulfill puzzling orders despite the angry wacky Cat being your boss. You are Wonderland's new chef.

name: Rana Card
summary: "Rana Card" is a roguelite card game where you manage a farm, complete KPI for the Frog. Draw cards in exciting, tense moments, you’ll navigate or exploit time explosion, earn packs and chests, build your deck, and play cards to earn gold. Face strategic choices, disasters, cataclysm along the way.

name: Sniper Warrior Elite
summary: Sniper Warrior Elite is a modern warfare sniping game that places players in the role of a skilled marksman. The game features a single-player campaign with open-ended maps, requiring tactical planning and precision. Players can customize their weapons and gear, adapting to various missions across diverse environments. The gameplay emphasizes realistic ballistics, weather effects, and stealth mechanics as players navigate through forests and urban areas to eliminate targets. Sniper Warrior Elite aims to provide a detailed sniping experience, challenging players to use strategy and marksmanship skills to complete their objectives.

name: Shrouded Aspect
summary: The God of Death wakes, unleashing a terrible plague before him. Lead your heroes across a medieval world inspired by Celtic mythology and uncover the source of the blight. Choose your allies, shape your party, and make the tough choices in this turn-based tactical combat RPG.

name: Death by Scrolling
summary: Welcome to Purgatory, now under new management! Death by Scrolling is a rogue-like vertically scrolling RPG where you kill enemies, collect gold, and avoid the Grim Reaper long enough to pay the Ferrymanʼs exorbitant river-crossing fee to the afterlife.

name: Morgenstern
summary: Embark on a medieval rogue-like journey, merging Survivor's hack-and-slay with souls-like rigor, in a third-person epic. Navigate dungeons, extract strategically, and inscribe your saga in the chronicles of legend.

name: Gold and Graves
summary: Gold and Graves is a roguelite deckbuilder where you can escape mid-dungeon to carry your cards, relics, and mercenaries into the next run. Bribe enemies to fight for you, push deeper for greater rewards.

name: Xenopurge
summary: Xenopurge is a tactical auto-battler where you are a Commander tasked with purging the Xenos threat. Operate from a remote command center, issuing indirect orders via multi-screen interfaces. Plan routes, set priorities, and adapt as missions escalate and feel the true weight of being in command.

name: Davy X Jones
summary: Ascend to the highest fathom of a pirate underworld with the infamous Davy Jones on this action-packed, revenge-driven journey. Control the captain's headless body, stay on pace with his autonomous skull and keep his legend alive.

name: Car Guys
summary: Experience the thrill of Car Guys, a high-octane multiplayer racing game! Represent your nation, compete in explosive races, and climb the global leaderboard. Customize your ride, engage in daily and weekly championships, and enjoy seamless online play with Photon Quantum. Join the race today!

name: Emotionless: The Last Ticket
summary: Liminal cosmic horror - you'll wander in an abandoned amusement park, walk along empty tunnels and crawl through narrow corridors. Join a ride and step into the dark. Explore eerie remains of a world that shouldn't exist. Find clues and discover the truth, but beware, some things should stay buried.

name: The Communist Manifesto
summary: The visual novel adaptation of The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. Experience the Manifesto in a conversational style for the first time and fully customize your reading.

name: Red Light
summary: Red Light is a retro-styled extraction shooter where you take a mission to raid an abandoned Soviet R&D Institute filled with mercenaries and living results of human experiments to solve the mystery of your disappeared brother.

name: RimPark: A Burning World
summary:
RimPark is a next-gen web-native game where Players attempt to master the magical abilities of their chosen Guardian in a quest to best their opponents before the fire consumes all. The gameplay style mixes MOBA and Battle Royale elements in an experience that can be enjoyed solo or as part of a team.

No installs, no downloads, no waiting. Just FUN!

name: Tree Kingdoms
summary: Winter approaches, Great Spirit. Rival Tree Kingdoms peck at your borders... Will you conquer, outlast, or outwit them in this bite-sized turn-based 4X struggle? Command your Treelings, adapt to the seasons, and etch your legend into the bark of history, before the cold claims all.

name: Outhold
summary: Outhold is a short, minimalistic incremental game that blends tower defense strategy with a deep meta-progression. Carve your own way through the sprawling skill tree, unlock powerful upgrades, and defend your Holdout from relentless waves of enemies.

name: Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol. 1
summary:
The Toaplan Arcade Collection Volume 1 is here with a bang! With modern enhancements, leaderboards, screen filters, quick save and other quality-of-life extras, anyone can experience these classic titles. Got what it takes? Prove it on the battlefield!

This collection includes Tiger-Heli, Flying Shark, Twin Cobra, Fire Shark, Out Zone, FixEight, Dogyuun, and Batsugun. It's octuple the action, a billion times the fun, and a thrill ride back in time to the neon-lit arcades of the past!

Through this re-release, a new generation of players will surely discover what made Toaplan such a special company, and their games timeless masterpieces. Now, let's blast some enemies!

name: Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol. 2
summary:
The Toaplan Arcade Collection Volume 2 is here with a bang! With modern enhancements, leaderboards, screen filters, quick save and other quality-of-life extras, anyone can experience these classic titles. Got what it takes? Prove it on the battlefield!

This collection includes Slap Fight, Truxton, Hellfire, Twin Hawk, Zero Wing, Vimana, Truxton II and Grind Stormer. It's octuple the action, a billion times the fun, and a thrill ride back in time to the neon-lit arcades of the past!

Through this re-release, a new generation of players will surely discover what made Toaplan such a special company, and their games timeless masterpieces. Now, let's blast some enemies!

name: Paranormal Torment
summary: Paranormal Torment is a psychological horror game in the spirit of P.T., where you're trapped in a loop of memory and guilt, forced to relive a tragedy over and over again. He's still waiting for you to come back...

name: Umami
summary: Umami is a cozy 3D food puzzle game where every level is a handcrafted, sensory experience. Tinker, rotate, and fit wooden blocks together to build mouthwatering food towers and fantastical cakes, all in a comfy atmosphere, like tidying a bento box for the soul.

name: A Better World
summary: A Better World Company is hiring! We’re looking for a skilled new recruit to alter the past and reshape the future! Use our Computer to travel back in time, and make game-changing choices to make the world a better place! You decide what to do… as long as you follow our internal policies.

name: Fireside Feelings
summary: Share your thoughts and discover those shared by others, in Fireside Feelings. Gather around the welcoming warmth of the campfire and take part in conversations between real people separated in space and time. Sometimes, we all need a good talk under the stars.

name: Eyes on the Exam
summary: Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.

name: Mage Food Truck
summary: Use your growing card collection to brave a hangry realm, crafting exotic meals in the face of fantastical beasts and curses from dissatisfied customers. A roguelike deckbuilder from the maker of Space Food Truck.

name: Day of Drift
summary: DAY OF DRIFT is an arcade - style drifting racing game!

name: RogueCraft
summary: Merge, build, and defend in this roguelike tower defense game! Face waves of enemies and epic bosses, evolve your towers, and unlock upgrades for endless replayability and tactical depth.

name: CoRoT
summary: CoRoT is a first-person psychological horror game. Search for cassettes in a transforming house, unraveling its macabre past. A sinister atmosphere surrounds you as you try to understand what's happening and where you really are. Can you discover the truth hidden in its walls?

name: Gorilla Vs 100 Men
summary: Can one gorilla beat 100 men? Step in, start swinging, and find out. Play as a gorilla in a chaotic ragdoll brawler where you punch, pummel, and try to survive. Go for 100 or push yourself in unlimited mode and see how long you last.

name: Swann's Song
summary: A boy and an old man stand in front a pond, waiting for a swan's song. Meanwhile, they talk about life, death, and the passage of time.

name: Temne
summary: Explore the landscape of the area, search for unique things in this place that can help you find your way out of here and don't die... because this is an adventure into the unknown and who knows what lies up ahead

name: The Trolley Solution
summary: The Trolley Solution is a compilation of point-and-click minigames based on the famous thought experiment originally proposed by Philippa Foot.

name: They Came for More Pasta
summary:
"When aliens order pasta, only one guy can deliver justice!"

You're a food delivery guy in this short, comical graphic adventure, determined to stop the monopoly on italian cousine imposed by an alien invasion.

name: Ed & Edda: Grand Prix – Racing Champions
summary: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions is a fun racing game for the whole family that brings the famous mascots of the Europa-Park to life. Players can - either alone or with their friends - race through several European landmarks to find out who is the fastest!

name: Hordelord
summary: Hordelord is a hi-octane arena mobility shooter (horde & endless modes) where you face waves of nasty enemies. Armed with powerful weapons and high-mobility skills, zip around and fight to achieve the highest score on global leaderboards. Hordelord sports tight gunplay, satisfying kills, and meaningful upgrades.

name: Ball x Pit
summary: BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite where you battle hordes of monstrous enemies with your arsenal of ricocheting balls.

name: The Salma World
summary: A gaming site that contains interactive games with chat on Twitch and chilling games, contain wheel , Tetris , countries war, question and answers games and drums of war, and more soon .. Most of them are interactive games with chat on Twitch.

name: Wuthering Waves: Lightly We Toss the Crown
summary:
Version 2.4 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Cartethyia and Lupa
• New areas: Septimont
• New story quests
• New outfits for Chagnli and Carlotta
• New echoes, events and more!

name: Unboxathon
summary: Unboxathon is a cute content-packed incremental game about opening mystery boxes. Find rare items, upgrade your skills, and unlock new boxes & features! Collect shiny items, pop bubble wrap, and materialize artifacts out of thin air. Can you find your lost childhood plush?

name: Dead Reset
summary: Trapped in a terrifying death-loop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.

name: SkullX: Aibohphobia
summary: You were hired to extract a bioengineer. Now your team is cut off, your comms are dead, and you're surrounded by something wearing human skin. Hold the line, make the calls, and survive the night in this choice-driven visual novel with turn-based combat.

name: Hunted Within: The Walls
summary: Dive into a gripping first-person horror Survival game Where you're trapped in a terrifying towering maze. Explore, craft tools and Fight by day, watch out over night when the Darkness hunts you within the walls. Uncover the truth behind the walls and Escape, or become a part of the nightmare.

name: Liminal City
summary: Liminal City is a psychological horror and exploration game based on found footage, set in Backrooms Level 11. Walk through the streets of Level 11, filled with soulless buildings, dynamically moving to different levels and searching for a way out. Once you fall in here will you be able to get out?

name: Raccateer
summary: Raccateer is a colony sim idle game. Recruit and upgrade raccoons each with unique personalities and stats, manage their equipment and synergize your team to become a Trashilionaire. Go from trash to riches in this tight, narrative-focused idler

name: Snowfall's Mystery
summary: A psychological interactive novel about a floppy disk with a mysterious program. Help Elliot cope with his mental issues and uncover the secret of the floppy disk.

name: Guardian Chicken
summary: Build towers, grow crops, and stop a mad scientist's undead army in this chaotic, comedy-filled tower defense game.

name: Organized Inside
summary: A slow-paced life simulation and tidying up game about a cat, passion, transformation and growth. Categorizing cluttered everyday household items, navigating ever-changing life experiences, while gradually uncovering the joys and meaning of life through methodical space organization.

name: Liuyin's World
summary: A 3D cyber-fantasy ARPG with metroidvania levels & multiple endings. Combat rewards aggression – hesitation means defeat. In a world where the Wheel of Reincarnation, corrupted by tainted energy, became an AI that merged flesh, souls, and machines to create new life, survivors reject this evolution.

name: Out of Stock!
summary: Team up with your friends in this frantic 4-player co-op party game! Order, restock, scrub the floor, but most importantly, keep your customers happy, or bad reviews will pile up fast!

name: Super Movie Tycoon
summary: Become a movie mogul in Super Movie Tycoon! From script to screen, build your dream team and create blockbusters to conquer Hollywood!

name: Letters of Longing
summary: It's a first-person game in which you'll have to find your way around a decaying building to find the information you've been sent to find. But along the way you might find something else.

name: No Man's Home
summary: You wander into the dangerous Asran Exclusion Zone. You will have to survive hunger, thirst, dangerous factions, radioactive emissions and the wild life. Remember, this is no man's home and you are not the hero.

name: Love Mansion
summary: As Akari's private tutor, manage her lessons and prepare her for success—all while uncovering the secrets of four captivating women in her family's luxurious mansion.

name: Nietzsche's Shadow
summary: A philosophical horror experience in the Alps: As Friedrich Nietzsche confronts his own shadow, he becomes lost between layers of reality.

name: Village Tale
summary: A relaxing idle village-building simulator nestled in the corner of your screen! Build, Craft, and Trade to guide your village from humble beginnings to a thriving trading hub, it's time to write your own Village Tale!

name: Lakeside Bar
summary: A cozy management sim where the jazz is smooth, the cocktails are cooler than the evening breeze, and the lake reflects your perfect escape.

name: Clown Is Hungry
summary: Clown Is Hungry is a comedy horror game about delivering a pizza to a hungry clown.

name: Card Shop Simulator Multiplayer
summary: You and your friends are going to compete to see whose card shop can earn more money! Starting from a humble little shop, decorate your store, hire staff, formulate marketing strategies. Finally, use the coolest cards to engage in card battles, and win away your friend's precious cards!

name: Apocalypse of the Universe
summary: In Apocalypse of Universe, players step into the shoes of an elf hero on a mission to save his homeland from a demonic invasion.

name: Empire Game
summary: Strategic game inspired by "Heroes of Might and Magic" & "Hero's Hour" with auto-battler combat. Multiple races embody real-world civilizations (China, France, etc.). Randomly generated maps ensure unique playthroughs. Adapt, expand, and conquer in a dynamic world!

name: Sky Dreamer
summary: Sky Dreamer blends sci-fi adventure with relaxed productivity. Use a customizable Pomodoro timer and to-do lists to stay on task as floating cities grow and futuristic landscapes inspire you. Discover soothing sounds and dynamic challenges to keep you focused and motivated!

name: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remaster
summary: A third-person action RPG that brings to life the world of Gaia from the Anima: Beyond Fantasy RPG table-top books. Explore a deep and multifaceted story where your choices and actions directly impact the journey and decide the fate of the characters.

name: Monsters Are Coming!
summary: Beware, monsters are coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Arch?

name: Dead Finger Dice: A Billionaire Killing Game
summary: Play a sinister game of poker dice against blood-thirsty demon billionaires who’ve trapped you on their mega yacht in this rogue-like dice builder.

name: Demeo x Dungeons & Dragons: Battlemarked
summary: A cooperative tactical RPG set in the D&D universe. Embark on a fantasy tabletop adventure. Your quest, on your schedule.

name: Road Food Simulator
summary: Run a roadside Pizza restaurant with your friends. Play solo or in Co-op with other players. Make pizzas fast and fill orders. Keep your customers happy and get more orders. Improve your restaurant as your income increases.

name: Dead Take
summary: Find your missing friend. Uncover the secrets within. Brave a luxurious and haunting mansion in Dead Take, a first-person psychological horror crafted by Surgent Studios.

name: Dustwind: Resistance
summary: Dustwind: Resistance is a single-player tactical game. Lead your squad—including your dog—against a brutal raider army. Pause to plan tactics. Use brutal firepower, stealth, traps, turrets, or an armored car to outmaneuver enemies. Protect your home and freedom. No surrender!

name: Sketch Magician
summary: A sketch action game where you fight with your drawings. You are a Sketch Magician. From arrow-like attacks to shields that block enemy attacks, everything is created from your sketches. Fight in the world of the sketchbook!

name: Postal: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze
summary: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze isn’t “just a DLC” - it’s a tropical serotonin collapse packed with juicy carnage, alleged jokes, overbaked new levels, even less appropriate enemies and unhinged guns. This is another mag of SPF-free mockery fired point-blank at modern life.

name: Lumines Arise
summary: A mind-blowing, fiendishly addictive reinvention of the puzzle classic Lumines from the creators of Tetris Effect: Connected, where sound pulses through your body, mind, and every block you place, triggering dazzling visuals synched to the driving beat of an infectious, eclectic soundtrack.

name: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles
summary: This dramatic tale of ambition, betrayal, and honor comes to life again with an updated and enriched script with fully voiced dialogue, alongside improved graphics that bring a new level of immersion and playability to the battlefield. Additionally, the enhanced version brings quality-of-life updates like new difficulties, a revamped UI, auto save, and more that make the game more accessible to newcomers.

name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection
summary:
Step into the arena and choose your fighter! Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection includes all the essential games from Mortal Kombat's early years. Experience the legendary origins of the franchise with the iconic arcade classics that started it all—alongside a curated selection of most-loved home versions for the Super NES and Sega Genesis. Dive deeper with rare and fan-favorite releases across the Game Boy, Game Gear, Sega 32X, Game Boy Advance, and more—a celebration of the franchise’s groundbreaking legacy.

Digital Eclipse's interactive documentary format explores how Mortal Kombat changed the way society perceived video games. By using digitized humans as player sprites in an over-the-top, martial-arts fighter, the game thrilled players, shocked critics, and laid the foundation for a franchise that has thrived for more than 30 years. Hear firsthand from the original dev team of Ed Boon, John Tobias, John Vogel, and Dan Forden, along with other exclusive interviews, rare concept art, vintage marketing materials, and archival video footage.

Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection also lets players explore Mortal Kombat lore, with a timeline of the original series' storyline and comprehensive character histories that offer stories, secrets, and glimpses behind the scenes at their creation.

name: Thief VR: Legacy of Shadow
summary: Step into the shadows in Thief VR. You are Magpie, a cunning thief orphaned by Baron Northcrest and shaped by the streets. Use VR mechanics to steal, evade, and outsmart the City's forces. Your goal? A relic in Northcrest's vault, which uncovers a far greater artifact with a powerful legacy.

name: Deus Ex: The Conspiracy
summary: The year is 2052 and the world is a dangerous and chaotic place. Terrorists operate openly - killing thousands; drugs, disease and pollution kill even more. The world's economies are close to collapse and the gap between the insanely wealthy and the desperately poor grows ever wider. Worst of all, an ages old conspiracy bent on world domination has decided that the time is right to emerge from the shadows and take control.

name: Twisted Metal III
summary: A digital re-edition of Twisted Metal III, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

name: Twisted Metal 4
summary: A digital re-edition of Twisted Metal 4, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

name: Resident Evil 2
summary:
A port of Resident Evil 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Resident Evil 2 is a sequel to the first Resident Evil title. Like the previous game in the series, Resident Evil 2 is a 3D action-adventure using three-dimensional polygon characters over two-dimensional pre-rendered backgrounds, with the action viewed through a variety of cinematic fixed camera angles in each room. Players can choose to play as one of two possible characters; each goes through the same initial scenario but with differences in the type of weaponry they find and the people they meet along the way.

name: Resident Evil 3: Nemesis
summary:
A port of Resident Evil 3 Nemesis, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Resident Evil 3: Nemesis is a survival horror video game and the third instalment in the Resident Evil series. Like its two predecessors, it is a third-person action-adventure game with polygonal characters on pre-rendered backgrounds with cinematic camera angles. Although the game uses the same basic engine and gameplay as the previous games, the gameplay is improved by features such as auto-targeting, a 180-degree spin, and a new dodge move that allows Jill to avoid enemy attacks.

name: Hybrid Blood
summary: Step into the role of a Vampire-Human Hybrid, imprisoned for longer than you can remember. Explore a Open-world RPG and expand your Vampiric Domain. Defeat the local Vampire Lord to claim his territory and begin your quest to dominate—or liberate—the lands.

name: The Stairwell
summary: You've been hired to keep watch in a mysterious building with an infinite stairwell. Your task is simple: investigate each floor for strange phenomena. If you find an anomaly, be careful. Test your skills on the global leaderboard and in the weekly challenge event.

name: Silent Hill f: Deluxe Edition
summary:
Silent Hill f is a survival horror game published by Konami as part of the Silent Hill series.
It is set in rural Japan during the 1960s, marking a departure from the franchise’s traditional Western settings. The story is written by Ryukishi07 and focuses on psychological horror, social pressure, and transformation.

The Deluxe Edition includes the full game along with a digital artbook, a digital soundtrack, and the Pink Rabbit costume. Pre-order bonuses for the Deluxe Edition consisted of the White Sailor School Uniform, the Omamori (Peony), an item pack, and 48-hour early access.

name: Find My Frogs
summary: Find My Frogs is a cozy hidden object game full of frogs, mushrooms and moss. Help Uncle Froger take a commemorative photo, or just lounge in the pond and relax.

name: Who's at the Door?
summary: You are trapped in a small house with psychosis, having lost your memory. Carefully observe your surroundings, distinguish between reality and hallucinations, and take the medication provided by visitors on time to overcome your illness.

name: Noble Legacy
summary:
After returning from war you claim your inheritance: Greenwood—a neglected realm on the brink of collapse. As its new Lord, you must guide your kingdom to greatness, not from a distant throne, but by walking its cobbled streets and verdant fields. In this third-person kingdom builder, you must raise your realm from rubble with a builder’s touch—every hall, heath, and castle wall crafted to your design.

Attract skilled settlers to your realm and keep their spirits high by ensuring their homes are furnished and their needs well met. Rule wisely over your land’s resources and build a thriving economy through careful management of trade and labor. Prepare in the times of plenty as harsh weather, plague, and roaming bandits can stall your progress. From the ashes of ruin, reclaim your land, guide your people, and uncover your past as you forge a Noble Legacy worthy of song and steel.

name: Skull Hotel
summary: A first-person horror game where you clean haunted hotel rooms while evading deadly entities. Inspect hiding spots carefully, listen for warning sounds, and spot subtle clues left by monsters. Your vigilance is your only weapon in this terrifying housekeeping shift.

name: Toy Smash Kaboom!
summary: Toy Warfare, Physics Collisions, Auto Chess, Space Management, Item Crafting, Trap Setting, Countless Playstyles—Every Combo is a Brand-New Adventure!​

name: Lots of Cats on an Adventure
summary: “Lots of Cats on an Adventure” is a game where you find hidden cats in comic strips, meow!

name: Can't Stop Rory
summary: By day, grow and decorate your cozy post-apocalyptic farm to meet government quotas, unlock new decorations and scale your farm. But beware, when night falls, the Unfed will try to take away everything that you've built. Lay traps, build turrets and deploy mechs to defend the last sustainable haven.

name: Genshin Impact: A Space and Time for You
summary:
Version 5.7 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Skirk and Dahlia
• New main story quest: "A Space and Time for You"
• New story quest for Skirk
• New endgame mode: Stygian Onslaught
• New main event: Battle of Imagined Arrays
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

name: Vartio
summary: Patrol a haunted forest as a lone medieval guard in this short psychological horror experience. Leave the safety of your watchtower, listen for threats in the dark, and uncover what's lurking beyond the trees—before paranoia consumes you.

name: Drywall Eating Simulator
summary: Drywall Eating Simulator is a physics-based 3D adventure game where you are pushed to the limits of human (or nonhuman) tolerance by the people you encounter in our world, and the only pressure release that you have is in the name of the game (eating drywall)

name: Star Ores Inc.
summary: Take over an abandoned space station and run your own ore mine. Carve your way through the asteroid with your laser, sell ore, and create an automated network of robot helpers to maximize your profit.

name: LEGO Voyagers
summary: From the makers of LEGO Builder's Journey comes a new 2-player co-op adventure about friendship and play. When two friends make it their mission to rescue an abandoned spaceship, they embark on a journey beyond their wildest dreams.

name: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny
summary: Bring iconic Nickelodeon heroes into a world of fantasy and real-time RPG action. Throw the dice and dive into a wild, action-packed adventure with a selection of Nickelodeon characters. Featuring epic battles, dynamic environments, it's an engaging gameplay experience for players of all ages.

name: Blade & Soul Heroes
summary: This thrilling free-to-play Collectible Action MMORPG offers the duality of turn-based strategy & real-time action. Experience exciting cross-platform play and embark on an epic quest where numerous stories are waiting to be discovered alongside your five member team. Unite your heroes!

name: Jurassic World Evolution 3
summary: Build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.

name: Marvel's Deadpool VR
summary: Deadpool VR is a game developed exclusively for Meta Quest 3/3S. The gameplay features a mix of parkour and combat.

name: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
summary: In this Roguelite set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

name: The First Descendant: Season 3
summary: Hoverbikes, 8-player Field Colossus Raids, and brand-new Descendants throughout this new season to experience.

name: LEGO Party!
summary: LEGO(R) Party! is a 4-player party game that's built different! Compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like Pirates, Space, NINJAGO and more. Play your way! Join your friends no matter their platform locally or online!

name: Street Fighter 6: Year 3 Character Pass
summary: Year 3 Character Pass - 4 additional characters (Sagat, C. Viper, Alex, Ingrid) - 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10 - Bonus: 3,000 Drive Tickets

name: Pocket Boss
summary: Who says that work and play don’t mix? Not us! Play Pocket Boss, the game where you handle lots of fun data and one not-so-fun boss.

name: End Them, Soldier!
summary: Near future. You are humanity's last hope for salvation. You must destroy everyone who stands in your way.

name: Bound Between Desks
summary: A mystical visual novel where ordinary school life intertwines with mysterious phenomena. Every decision you make could lead to uncovering secrets... or plunge you into even greater uncertainty.

name: ReDrop
summary: DIE, REDROP, REPEAT. In this Platformer, every Death leaves a platform behind; Climb your mistakes! RAGE, CRY, ADAPT. Then do it all again. Try now and prove you're only *mostly* bad.

name: The Joker's Game
summary: "The Joker's Game" is an FMV crime battle royale. Jack, drowning in debt, joins a lethal game. Critical choices, even small ones, shape outcomes. Outwit rivals, uncover truths, or perish? Every move decides survival... or the deadly prize.

name: Leaf Blower Co.
summary: Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

name: Anxiety Puppy
summary: Anxiety Puppy is a 2D interactive narrative game that focuses on anxiety. In the game, anxiety is personified as a little puppy. Players will explore its story and try to coexist with it. Go find its traces and give it a hug.

name: Nano Neighbors
summary: An online idle game that brings life to the bottom of your screen with friendly androids called NANOs. Customise your NANOs, choose their occupation, build and design their perfect home, and invite your friends' NANOs over to hang out, join mini-activities, and interact.

name: Reach
summary:
The ground-breaking cinematic action-adventure from nDreams Elevation – the VR immersion expert’s pioneering new studio.

Embody a reluctant hero, wield extraordinary abilities, and journey into a perilous world of crossed realities. Make every move matter to shape your destiny. Are you ready to make the leap?

name: Milano’s Odd Job Collection
summary: Milano is on her own for summer vacation, and she’s ready to live her best life! Take on part-time jobs, personalize your home, or spend the day eating popcorn at the park. Experience this retro classic for the first time outside of Japan, now with modern improvements.
